33935344.clinical_problem: Can fetal gestational age be estimated fully automatically from low-cost obstetric ultrasound, to help establish gestational age without skilled sonographers in low- and middle-income countries?
33935344.patient_population: obstetric ultrasound images from an expert-sonographer-annotated database
33935344.model_description: An automated pipeline classifies, segments, and measures several fetal structures (biparietal diameter, head circumference, crown-rump length, abdominal circumference, femur length) from ultrasound images, then estimates gestational age using the Hadlock equation on the automated measurements.
33935344.dataset_size: not stated (large database of annotated obstetric US images)
33935344.headline_result: 93% classification accuracy; mean IoU 0.91 for segmentation; mean measurement error 1.89 cm; 1.4-day mean gestational age error versus expert sonographer estimate
33935344.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and internal testing

33937051.clinical_problem: Can CT radiomics, before surgery, predict event-free survival in children with hepatoblastoma, to help inform treatment planning?
33937051.patient_population: 88 patients with histologically confirmed hepatoblastoma (mean age 2.28 +/- 2.72 years), from two institutions
33937051.model_description: A radiomics signature, extracted from pretreatment portal-venous-phase CT and combined via LASSO Cox regression with clinicopathologic risk factors, produces a nomogram predicting event-free survival after hepatoblastoma treatment.
33937051.headline_result: Combined radiomics-clinicopathologic nomogram C-index 0.88 (95% CI 0.829-0.933), improved over the clinicopathologic model alone (C-index 0.81 vs 0.85 reported for radiomics vs clinical)
33937051.study_design: retrospective two-institution radiomics model development with external validation

33977357.exclusion_reason: Describes a data-model/interoperability standard (DICOM-MIABIS integration) for linking imaging metadata to biobank standards; not itself an AI/ML diagnostic or prognostic model, nor a review of clinical AI use

34026680.exclusion_reason: Animal model study (near-term fetal sheep), not human patients

34353792.exclusion_reason: Uses a digital auscultatory stethoscope (phonocardiogram/ECG waveform data), not radiologic imaging; study protocol only (no results yet)

34474195.model_family: hybrid CNN (GoogleNet, MobileNetV2, DenseNet201 features + mRMR feature selection)
34474195.clinical_problem: Can vesicoureteral reflux be automatically diagnosed and graded from voiding cystourethrography images in children, supporting evaluation of children with recurrent urinary tract infections?
34474195.patient_population: Pediatric patients diagnosed with VUR between 2016 and 2021: 236 normal and 992 VUR images
34474195.model_description: A hybrid deep learning model extracts and concatenates features from three pretrained CNNs (GoogLeNet, MobileNetV2, DenseNet201), selects the most relevant features using minimum-redundancy-maximum-relevance, and classifies voiding cystourethrography images into six classes (normal or VUR grade 1-5).
34474195.headline_result: Highest accuracy 96.9% with the proposed hybrid model
34474195.study_design: retrospective single-center model development and testing

34773476.model_family: two-stage machine learning (logistic LASSO cure model + survival model)
34773476.clinical_problem: Can machine learning predict, using ultrasound and clinical findings, which children will develop recurrent ureteropelvic junction obstruction after pyeloplasty, to enable personalized follow-up?
34773476.patient_population: 543 patients under 18 undergoing pyeloplasty (2008-2020); 232 in the survival model
34773476.model_description: A two-stage machine learning model (logistic LASSO for a binary 'cure' classification, followed by a survival model) uses 34 clinical fields, including postoperative ultrasound anteroposterior renal pelvis diameter and anatomical variation, to predict risk and timing of recurrent obstruction after pyeloplasty; deployed as a web calculator.
34773476.study_design: retrospective single-center model development with leave-one-out cross-validation

34777962.model_family: deep learning with unsupervised region localization
34777962.clinical_problem: Can bone age assessment from hand-wrist x-rays be made more objective and less dependent on individual physician experience, using a deep-learning computer-aided diagnosis method?
34777962.patient_population: public RSNA bone age dataset, plus an additional dataset
34777962.model_description: An unsupervised method first localizes informative hand regions, then a pretrained backbone image model with a small prediction head (incorporating gender as an embedded input) estimates bone age from the hand radiograph.
34777962.dataset_size: public RSNA bone age dataset plus an additional dataset
34777962.headline_result: Mean absolute error 6.2 months on the public RSNA dataset and 5.1 months on the additional dataset (MobileNetV3 backbone)
34777962.study_design: retrospective model development and benchmarking on public and additional datasets

34911201.clinical_problem: Can pre-treatment resting-state functional MRI predict, at the individual level, which youth with PTSD will respond to trauma-focused psychotherapy, to help guide treatment selection?
34911201.patient_population: 40 youth (ages 8-17) with (partial) PTSD before trauma-focused psychotherapy
34911201.model_description: A cross-validated multivariate support vector machine classifier uses resting-state fMRI functional connectivity, based on independent-component-derived brain networks, to predict individual-level response to trauma-focused psychotherapy in youth with PTSD.
34911201.headline_result: Individual-level prediction accuracy 76% (pFWE=0.02), 87% sensitivity, 65% specificity, AUC 0.82, using a superior temporal gyrus-centered network

34968393.clinical_problem: Can improved loss functions for deep learning multi-class classifiers more reliably distinguish normal chest x-rays from bacterial and viral pneumonia in children, given that abnormalities are often imbalanced across classes?
34968393.patient_population: pediatric chest x-ray dataset (normal, bacterial pneumonia, viral pneumonia)
34968393.model_description: Multiple state-of-the-art and newly proposed loss functions are benchmarked for training deep neural network classifiers on a pediatric chest x-ray dataset (normal vs. bacterial vs. viral pneumonia), with prediction-level and model-level ensembling and localization studies to interpret model behavior.
34968393.headline_result: Weighted-averaging top-3/top-5 model-level ensembles achieved MCC 0.9068 (95% CI 0.8839-0.9297), significantly better than individual models and prior literature (p<0.05)
34968393.study_design: retrospective benchmarking and ensemble-model development study

35118028.clinical_problem: Can standard echocardiographic views be automatically recognized in children, a prerequisite step for automated diagnosis of congenital heart defects?
35118028.model_description: A deep learning neural network using knowledge distillation automatically identifies 23 standard echocardiographic views commonly used to diagnose congenital heart defects in children.
35118028.headline_result: F1 scores >=0.90 for a majority of the 23 standard views
35118028.study_design: retrospective single-center model development and internal testing

32544594.clinical_problem: How can radiomics and neural-network-based AI be applied across the pediatric nuclear medicine/molecular imaging workflow, from image acquisition to diagnosis and therapy planning?
32544594.model_description: Review of artificial intelligence and radiomics applications in pediatric molecular imaging (nuclear medicine), covering the radiomics feature-extraction pipeline, the shift toward neural networks that learn features directly from images, and use cases grouped into automating administrative/clinical tasks, augmenting broader tasks, and unlocking new value (e.g., intelligent order sets, automated protocoling, image acquisition, computer-aided triage/detection, biomarker development, therapy planning).

33031859.model_family: deep learning tract segmentation (TractSeg) plus fixel-based analysis
33031859.clinical_problem: Do children with ADHD and fine motor difficulties show measurable differences in corticospinal tract microstructure on diffusion MRI, using an automated deep-learning tract-delineation approach?
33031859.patient_population: 50 right-handed medication-naive children with ADHD and 56 non-ADHD controls, ages 9-11
33031859.model_description: A semi-automated deep-learning tool (TractSeg) delineates the corticospinal tract bilaterally on high-angular-resolution diffusion MRI, from which fixel-based metrics (fibre density, cross-section) are extracted and compared between children with and without ADHD.
33031859.headline_result: Children with ADHD showed significantly lower diffusion (fixel-based) metrics bilaterally in the corticospinal tract versus controls, but no significant correlation with fine motor task performance
33031859.study_design: prospective single-center case-control diffusion MRI study using an automated deep-learning segmentation tool

33338616.exclusion_reason: Animal model study (rhesus and cynomolgus macaques), not human pediatric patients

31252177.exclusion_reason: Uses functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS), a non-standard, non-radiologic optical imaging modality; no machine learning/AI model applied (standard statistical comparison of brain activity)

31681456.clinical_problem: Automatically extracting the brain from surrounding tissue (skull stripping) on infant brain MRI, since existing methods are tuned to adult anatomy
31681456.patient_population: 343 infant MRI scans, newborns to 48 months old
31681456.model_description: Input: infant brain MRI images; output: skull-stripped brain segmentation mask, via a flattened residual CNN with a boundary loss and an artifact simulator for augmentation
31681456.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and internal testing

31911233.exclusion_reason: no imaging; epidemiologic/statistical study of childhood leukemia risk factors, not radiology

30392059.clinical_problem: Automatically segmenting knee growth-plate structures on MRI to support chronological age estimation in adolescents and young adults lacking legal documentation
30392059.patient_population: 76 knee MRI datasets; age estimation proof-of-concept on 145 subjects (14-subject test set)
30392059.model_description: Input: 3D knee MR images; output: automatic segmentation of growth-plate structures used to derive estimated chronological age, via a U-Net-style encoder-decoder CNN
30392059.dataset_size: 76 MRI datasets (segmentation); 145 subjects for age estimation, 14-subject test set
30392059.headline_result: Dice 98%, IoU 96% for segmentation; mean absolute age error 0.48 ± 0.32 years (14-subject test set)
30392059.study_design: retrospective algorithm development, proof-of-concept internal validation

30515594.exclusion_reason: prediction model built on uroflowmetry/clinical parameters (Qmax, voiding time, etc.), not image-based analysis

30542259.clinical_problem: Distinguishing individuals with autism spectrum disorder from controls using patterns of brain network connectivity and signal irregularity on resting-state fMRI
30542259.patient_population: Individuals with ASD and controls from the ABIDE cohort (ages not stated in abstract)
30542259.model_description: Input: resting-state fMRI functional connectivity and wavelet-based temporal entropy across 264 brain regions; output: model distinguishing ASD from control individuals and associated with symptom severity
30542259.headline_result: RSN entropy model significantly distinguished ASD from controls (p=0.01)
30542259.study_design: retrospective cross-sectional analysis of a public neuroimaging cohort

28506958.clinical_problem: Automatically determining presence or absence of bacterial pneumonia in children from the text of chest imaging reports, to support large-scale comparative effectiveness research
28506958.patient_population: Children in the multi-institutional PHIS+ clinical repository; 282 reports manually annotated for training/testing
28506958.model_description: Input: free-text pediatric chest diagnostic imaging reports; output: extracted imaging findings and automatic classification of whether the report is consistent with bacterial pneumonia, via an NLP application with machine learning algorithms
28506958.headline_result: finding extraction sensitivity 0.939, PPV 0.925; report classification sensitivity 0.71, PPV 0.86, specificity 0.962
28506958.study_design: pilot study, retrospective NLP model development and testing

29060160.clinical_problem: Automatically segmenting the fetal body and amniotic fluid on prenatal ultrasound images
29060160.patient_population: Clinical fetal ultrasound data (sample size not stated)
29060160.model_description: Input: fetal ultrasound images; output: pixel-wise segmentation of fetal tissue and amniotic fluid, via an encoder-decoder deep learning network fine-tuned from a pretrained model

26755063.exclusion_reason: animal study (mice); not human/clinical pediatric radiology

28133417.clinical_problem: Automatically labeling (segmenting) the hippocampus on brain MRI in both adult and infant subjects to support imaging-based brain studies
28133417.patient_population: Adult and infant brain MRI datasets (sizes not stated, described as 'large datasets')
28133417.model_description: Input: adult and infant brain MRI; output: automatic hippocampus segmentation labels, via a concatenated set of spatially-localized random forest classifiers with auto-context refinement

28269461.exclusion_reason: accelerometer-based fetal movement detection; not an imaging modality

26142072.exclusion_reason: conventional task-based fMRI analysis of feedback/reward effects; no machine learning/AI model

26241982.clinical_problem: Estimating the risk of trisomy 21 and other chromosomal aneuploidies at 11-13 weeks of gestation using sonographic and biochemical markers
26241982.model_description: Input: sonographic markers (e.g., crown-rump length), biochemical markers, and maternal data; output: estimated risk of euploidy, trisomy 21, or other chromosomal aneuploidy, via an artificial neural network

26835496.clinical_problem: Identifying quantitative MRI imaging features of the inferior olivary nuclei that predict development of posterior fossa syndrome after pediatric brain tumor resection
26835496.patient_population: 28 pediatric patients with longitudinal pre-, intra-, and postoperative brain MRI after posterior fossa tumor resection
26835496.model_description: Input: semi-automatically segmented inferior olivary nuclei on longitudinal brain MRI with extracted statistical imaging features; output: classification of patients as having or not having posterior fossa syndrome, via a support vector machine
26835496.headline_result: statistically significant improvement in classification using left ION hyperintensity feature (exact p-value not given as a number)

20879452.clinical_problem: Triaging pulmonary abnormalities (e.g., tuberculosis) on pediatric chest radiographs for specialist interpretation in resource-poor, high-TB-burden settings
20879452.patient_population: Pediatric anterior-posterior digital chest radiographs (sample size not stated)
20879452.model_description: Input: pediatric digital chest X-ray images; output: a per-region probability map indicating degree of pulmonary abnormality, via lung field segmentation, subdivision, feature extraction and classification

19847068.exclusion_reason: narrative review of EEG/ERP-based compensation mechanisms across the lifespan; not radiology AI and not pediatric-specific

38197584.clinical_problem: Detecting fetal atrioventricular septal defect (AVSD) on prenatal cardiac ultrasound four-chamber images, and studying how AI advice (with or without confidence/explanation) affects clinician diagnostic accuracy
38197584.patient_population: 173 ultrasound scan videos (98 normal hearts, 75 AVSD) yielding 121,130 four-chamber images; 10 clinicians (fetal cardiologists, trainees, sonographers) tested on 500 images across 4 conditions
38197584.model_description: Input: fetal four-chamber cardiac ultrasound images; output: binary classification (normal vs. AVSD) with confidence score and Grad-CAM overlay, via a ResNet50 model, studied in human-AI collaboration experiments
38197584.dataset_size: 121,130 images from 173 videos (98 normal, 75 AVSD); reader study of 500 images, 20,000 classifications from 10 clinicians
38197584.headline_result: AI alone accuracy 0.798; clinicians alone 0.844; clinicians with correct AI binary output 0.865 (P<.001); accuracy fell to 0.693 with incorrect AI advice
38197584.study_design: retrospective model development with prospective reader study of human-AI collaboration

38246249.clinical_problem: Whether AI auto-segmentation models trained on adult CT data accurately contour organs on pediatric CT for radiation therapy planning, and how much pediatric training data improves performance
38246249.patient_population: 459 pediatric (0-16 years) and 950 adult (>18 years) CT scans with expert contours

38054056.model_family: advanced machine learning models allowing non-linear relationships and modeling disorder interdependencies (vs. traditional linear models)
38054056.clinical_problem: predicting 10 psychiatric disorders (e.g., depression, bipolar disorder, ADHD) in children from structural brain MRI
38054056.patient_population: 6916 children aged 9-10, multicenter Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) study
38054056.model_description: Input: 136 regional brain volume and cortical thickness measures from structural MRI; output: predicted presence of each of 10 psychiatric disorders, using advanced non-linear, interdependency-modeling machine learning.

38083494.model_family: conditional generative adversarial network (cGAN) using class activation maps as prior
38083494.clinical_problem: generating synthetic fetal-head standard-plane ultrasound images to augment limited annotated training data for classifiers that support diagnosis of neural anomalies during gestation
38083494.patient_population: fetal ultrasound (largest publicly available fetal head standard plane dataset)
38083494.model_description: Input: class activation maps from a fetal-head-standard-plane classification algorithm, used as a conditional prior; output: synthetic realistic ultrasound images of three standard planes (trans-cerebellum, trans-thalamic, trans-ventricular) to augment training data.
38083494.study_design: methods development, evaluated via t-SNE visualization

38090385.model_family: 13 machine learning algorithms compared; extreme gradient boosting, random forest, and adaptive boosting best (random forest most accurate)
38090385.clinical_problem: predicting bone marrow metastasis in neuroblastoma noninvasively using MRI radiomics
38090385.model_description: Input: 572 radiomics features extracted from MRI (41 selected); output: prediction of bone marrow metastasis presence, best performance from a random forest classifier.

38144472.model_family: deep learning optimized with a custom AI algorithm for joint training and automated feature selection
38144472.clinical_problem: predicting onset of ADHD, oppositional defiant disorder, and conduct disorder in early adolescence using multimodal predictors including structural and functional MRI
38144472.patient_population: children aged 9-10 and their parents, Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) cohort, followed to age 11-12
38144472.model_description: Input: 5777 multimodal candidate predictors including structural and functional MRI metrics, psychosocial measures, and parent-reported traits; output: individual-level prediction of onset of ADHD, ODD, and CD at 2-year follow-up.
38144472.headline_result: Multimodal models: ~86-97% accuracy, AUROC 0.919-0.996; neural-metrics-only models: ~80% accuracy and AUROC
38144472.study_design: prospective cohort with deep-learning prediction, tested on held-out unseen data

39491304.clinical_problem: estimating 3D fetal pose (anatomical landmarks) from 3D ultrasound to support biometric measurement, plane localization and fetal movement monitoring
39491304.model_description: Input: 3D fetal ultrasound volumes; output: estimated 3D positions of 22 fetal anatomical landmarks (pose), supporting biometric measurement, plane localization, and movement monitoring.
39491304.study_design: methods development and comparison against other pose-estimation methods

34806646.clinical_problem: improving CT angiography image quality (reducing noise while preserving contrast-to-noise ratio) in children with Takayasu arteritis
34806646.patient_population: 32 children with Takayasu arteritis, 9.14±4.51 years old
34806646.model_description: Input: raw CT angiography projection data; output: reconstructed images with reduced noise and improved contrast-to-noise ratio, compared against filtered back-projection and iterative reconstruction.
34806646.headline_result: DLIR-high setting: noise 15.58±3.65 HU, aorta CNR 24.02±4.55 (best among all reconstructions); subjective nasal-cavity score 3.53±0.51

35194075.model_family: random forest classifier on radiomic features
35194075.clinical_problem: noninvasively diagnosing pediatric cervical lymphadenopathy etiology (non-tuberculous mycobacterial vs. pyogenic vs. reactive/proliferative) via CT radiomics
35194075.patient_population: 249 lymph nodes from 143 CT scans of pediatric patients with lymphadenopathy, Montreal Children's Hospital, 2005-2018
35194075.model_description: Input: CT images of cervical lymph nodes; output: classification into pyogenic, non-tuberculous mycobacterial (NTM), reactive, or proliferative lymphadenopathy, using the 10 most discriminative of 1231 extracted radiomic features.
35194075.headline_result: 4-class accuracy 72%, precision 68%, recall 70%; AUC 89% (NTM vs. all), 90% (NTM vs. pyogenic), 93% (NTM vs. reactive/proliferative)

35233665.clinical_problem: automatically estimating chronological age from knee radiographs in pediatric patients, for forensic, medicolegal, and clinical use
35233665.patient_population: 3816 knee radiographs (training, German population, 2008-2018); 423 (internal validation, 2019-2020); 197 (external validation)
35233665.model_description: Input: knee radiograph; output: estimated chronological age (regression) and binary age-class classification (e.g., <14 vs. >=14 years).
35233665.headline_result: Mean absolute error 0.86±0.72 years (internal) and 0.9±0.71 years (external); AUC 0.94-0.98 for age-class separation
35233665.study_design: retrospective model development with internal and external validation cohorts

35239221.clinical_problem: real-time identification of fetal anomalies via AI-assisted ultrasound
35239221.model_description: Editorial/commentary discussing the current state and future directions of real-time AI-based detection of fetal anomalies on ultrasound (no abstract available).

35289571.exclusion_reason: general clinical review of pediatric heart murmur evaluation/management; AI mentioned only in passing regarding phonocardiography (an audio, not imaging, technology)

35317533.exclusion_reason: commentary on thoracic ultrasound scale-up for TB diagnosis; AI mentioned only in passing as a future consideration, with no AI model developed or evaluated

35341955.model_family: random forest (with backward stepwise regression as comparator)
35341955.clinical_problem: using machine learning on echocardiographic measurements to explain/estimate invasively measured markers of left ventricular diastolic dysfunction in children
35341955.patient_population: 59 children at risk for diastolic dysfunction (Kawasaki disease, heart transplant, aortic stenosis, coarctation of the aorta) undergoing cardiac catheterization
35341955.model_description: Input: echocardiographic diastolic-function measurements, demographic data and clinical diagnosis; output: prediction/explanation of invasively measured diastolic dysfunction markers (tau, LV end-diastolic pressure, max negative dP/dt).
35341955.headline_result: Random forest models noninferior to linear regression; top features included propagation velocity for tau and E/propagation-velocity ratio for LV end-diastolic pressure (no single AUC reported)

35455095.exclusion_reason: predicts maternal risk of emergency cesarean section from clinical/demographic variables (fetal sonographic findings only a minor input); not a fetal/pediatric imaging diagnostic AI model

35493614.exclusion_reason: review of Theory of Mind in cognitive science and AI; not diagnostic imaging

35536111.model_family: lightweight deep convolutional neural network with depthwise separable convolution
35536111.clinical_problem: automatic, computationally efficient fetal head circumference measurement from 2D ultrasound to assess fetal development
35536111.model_description: Input: 2D fetal ultrasound images; output: fetal head segmentation, post-processed (morphological processing plus least-squares ellipse fitting) to compute head circumference.
35536111.release_evidence: the code for our method is also publicly available on https://github.com/ApeMocker/CSM-for-fetal-HC-measurement
35536111.headline_result: Mean absolute difference 1.97±1.89 mm; Dice similarity coefficient 97.61±1.72% (HC18 test set)
35536111.study_design: retrospective model development on a public benchmark dataset

35538388.clinical_problem: predicting skull dysmorphology severity and post-surgical outcome in children with isolated sagittal synostosis
35538388.patient_population: 105 infants/children with isolated sagittal synostosis treated surgically
35538388.model_description: Input: preoperative high-resolution CT of the sagittal suture and its anterior/central/posterior sections; output: predicted scaphocephalic severity and post-surgical outcome via radiomics-based logistic regression.
35538388.headline_result: Severity model AUC 0.71, PPV 0.83; outcome model AUC 0.75 (0.61-0.88), NPV 0.95 (0.84-0.99)

35606398.model_family: physics-based numerical simulation (not a trained neural network itself)
35606398.clinical_problem: providing a realistic simulated fetal brain MRI dataset with known ground truth to validate and optimize image-processing algorithms, given the scarcity of real high-quality fetal MRI data

35606398.model_description: Input: known ground-truth fetal brain anatomy and stochastic fetal-motion parameters; output: simulated clinical T2-weighted fast-spin-echo fetal brain MR images, used here to validate and optimize a super-resolution reconstruction algorithm and to support deep-learning fetal brain segmentation training.
35606398.release_evidence: open-source Fetal Brain magnetic resonance Acquisition Numerical phantom
35606398.study_design: simulation-tool development with demonstration on a super-resolution reconstruction algorithm

35616956.exclusion_reason: non-radiologic imaging (retinal OCT for retinopathy of prematurity), excluded modality

35658908.clinical_problem: improving image quality of low-dose CT of the paranasal sinuses in children using deep learning image reconstruction compared to iterative reconstruction
35658908.model_description: Input: low-dose paranasal sinus CT raw data; output: reconstructed images at three DLIR intensity levels, compared against filtered back-projection and adaptive statistical iterative reconstruction (ASiR-V).
35658908.headline_result: High-intensity DLIR produced the lowest image noise and best contrast-to-noise ratio and subjective image-quality ranking among all tested reconstructions

35712286.exclusion_reason: dental imaging (orthopantomography/panoramic dental radiograph), excluded modality

35790559.patient_population: pediatric radiology research data subjects (general, multi-institutional AI-enabled research databases)
35790559.model_description: Review of data governance and stewardship principles (privacy, security, bias mitigation, ethical use) for multi-institutional AI-enabled pediatric radiology research databases, summarizing adaptable centralized and distributed data governance frameworks.

35882938.clinical_problem: predicting neonatal respiratory morbidity using prenatal ultrasound-based radiomics texture analysis of the fetal lung
35882938.patient_population: 295 singleton pregnancies, fetal lung ultrasound obtained 28+3 to 37+6 weeks gestation within 72 hours before delivery
35882938.model_description: Input: four-chamber-view fetal lung ultrasound images (20 selected radiomics features) plus 2 clinical features (gestational age, pregnancy complications); output: predicted risk of neonatal respiratory morbidity.

35932003.clinical_problem: predicting risk of spontaneous miscarriage from early-pregnancy ultrasound gestational sac images despite initially positive fetal cardiac activity
35932003.patient_population: 1098 women with early singleton pregnancies, gestational age 6-8 weeks (2196 images, training); two independent test sets of 136 patients/272 images each
35932003.model_description: Input: early-pregnancy ultrasound gestational-sac images; output: predicted risk of spontaneous miscarriage, compared against manual measurement of crown-rump length and fetal heart rate.
35932003.dataset_size: 2196 images from 1098 women (training); two test sets of 136 patients/272 images each
35932003.headline_result: AUC 0.857 (retrospective test), 0.885 (prospective test); accuracy 80.32%/78.1%; manual CRL+FHR AUC only 0.687
35932003.study_design: case-control retrospective study with a prospective validation cohort

35946944.model_family: 3D-ResNet with inception, deep learning with gradient-based backtracking (explainability)
35946944.clinical_problem: identifying structural brain abnormalities to aid early diagnosis of autism spectrum disorder in preschoolers and young adolescents
35946944.patient_population: preschool dataset (110 participants), public ABIDE dataset (1099 participants), and an epilepsy verification dataset (200 participants)
35946944.model_description: Input: T1-weighted structural brain MRI; output: classification of autism spectrum disorder vs. typical development, with a gradient-based backtracking method identifying the brain regions driving each classification.
35946944.study_design: case-control classification study across multiple independent datasets

35966548.exclusion_reason: model uses maternal-fetal electrocardiography (ECG) signals, not diagnostic imaging

35991581.clinical_problem: detecting intussusception on abdominal ultrasound in children
35991581.patient_population: 440 cases (373 pediatric intussusception, 67 normal) retrospectively collected from a children's hospital
35991581.model_description: An improved Faster R-CNN object detector takes abdominal ultrasound images as input and outputs detection/classification of the 'concentric circle' sign used to diagnose intussusception.
35991581.headline_result: Detection: 92.8% detection rate, 95.0% recall, 92.2% specificity, F1 86.4%; classification accuracy 93.0% on validation set
35991581.study_design: retrospective single-center model development with internal validation

36047281.body_region: craniofacial, shoulder and pelvic growth centers
36047281.clinical_problem: delineating skeletal growth centers to avoid radiation-induced growth abnormalities during childhood cancer radiotherapy planning
36047281.patient_population: 107 childhood cancer patients undergoing radiotherapy planning (training n=80, test n=27)
36047281.model_description: A modified U-Net with triplet-attention branches takes axial/coronal/sagittal CT slices as input and outputs auto-segmented contours of 19 skeletal growth-center structures.
36047281.headline_result: Average Dice 0.77-0.87 across groups; auto-contouring cut manual correction time by 72% (37.6 min saved of 52.2 min)
36047281.study_design: retrospective model development with internal test-cohort validation

36068030.clinical_problem: measuring axial vertebral rotation on radiographs to assess scoliosis progression risk
36068030.patient_population: 221 vertebrae from 17 spinal radiographs of adolescents with idiopathic scoliosis
36068030.model_description: CNN-based segmentation (spinal column, individual vertebra, pedicles) on posteroanterior radiographs is used to automatically calculate axial vertebral rotation, compared with manual measurement.
36068030.headline_result: 81% of automatic measurements within clinical acceptance error (±5°); mean absolute difference 4.3° ± 5.7° vs. manual
36068030.study_design: retrospective method-development study comparing automatic vs. manual measurement

36090673.clinical_problem: distinguishing bipolar disorder from major depressive disorder in adolescents
36090673.patient_population: 309 adolescents from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) study (116 bipolar disorder, 64 major depressive disorder, 129 healthy)
36090673.model_description: A multimodal support vector machine takes resting-state functional connectivity plus structural MRI measures (cortical thickness, area, volume, sulcal depth) as input and classifies adolescents into diagnostic groups (bipolar disorder, major depressive disorder, healthy).
36090673.headline_result: Multimodal classifier: 98.5% MDD vs. bipolar; leave-one-site-out accuracy 63.3-81.7%
36090673.study_design: retrospective multi-site classifier development with leave-one-site-out validation

36113502.exclusion_reason: clinical decision-tree model using only clinical and laboratory parameters, explicitly without imaging, for pediatric appendicitis diagnosis

36207092.clinical_problem: segmenting multiple bones on pediatric musculoskeletal MRI for morphological/diagnostic evaluation
36207092.patient_population: pediatric ankle and shoulder MRI datasets, pathological and healthy examinations
36207092.model_description: A pre-trained convolutional encoder-decoder segmentation network, regularized with shape priors from an auto-encoder and an adversarial discriminator, takes pediatric MR images as input and outputs multi-bone segmentation masks.
36207092.dataset_size: not stated (two scarce pediatric imaging datasets from ankle and shoulder joints)
36207092.headline_result: Outperformed or matched prior approaches on Dice, sensitivity, specificity and surface-distance metrics (exact values not given in abstract)

36238349.exclusion_reason: EEG-based pain classification; non-imaging physiological signal, not radiology

36348326.clinical_problem: bone age assessment in preschool children and its effect on reader agreement
36348326.patient_population: 56 bone age radiographs of preschool children (3-6 years) read by 6 residents
36348326.model_description: AI-assisted bone age software estimates skeletal maturity from hand-wrist radiographs (TW3-RUS and TW3-Carpal) to assist resident readers, compared against expert-consensus reference bone age.
36348326.release_evidence: AI-assisted diagnosis software for bone age described as a deployed clinical tool
36348326.headline_result: AI assistance improved inter- and intra-observer ICC agreement and reduced RMSE/MAD vs. no AI assistance

36680923.clinical_problem: discriminating developmental dyslexia, developmental coordination disorder, and their comorbidity in children using brain imaging
36680923.patient_population: 136 children (42 typically developing, 45 dyslexia, 20 coordination disorder, 29 comorbid)
36680923.model_description: Machine learning models are trained on structural (grey/white matter volume) and resting-state functional MRI indices (activity, local/global connectivity) to discriminate between developmental dyslexia, developmental coordination disorder, and comorbid children.
36680923.headline_result: No single imaging index discriminated groups alone; combined structural or functional models could discriminate among groups (no single accuracy figure given)

37614415.clinical_problem: improving downstream segmentation of longitudinal brain MRI, including developing infant brain MRI, by better pretraining
37614415.patient_population: longitudinal neurodegenerative adult MRI and developing infant brain MRI cohorts (sizes not stated)
37614415.model_description: A local, multi-scale spatiotemporal self-supervised pretraining method for image-to-image architectures takes longitudinal MRI scans as input and learns representations later fine-tuned for segmentation tasks with a self-supervised consistency regularization.
37614415.headline_result: Outperformed randomly-initialized baselines and existing self-supervised techniques on segmentation benchmarks (no single number reported in abstract)
37614415.study_design: retrospective method-development study benchmarked across segmentation tasks

33436974.clinical_problem: measuring ventricular volume in preterm infants with post-hemorrhagic ventricular dilatation
33436974.patient_population: 152 serial 3D ultrasound scans from 10 preterm infants with post-hemorrhagic ventricular dilatation (mean birth weight 1233 g, mean GA 28.1 weeks)
33436974.model_description: A 2D convolutional neural network takes 3D cranial ultrasound volumes as input and outputs automatic segmentation of brain ventricles, from which ventricular volume is calculated.
33436974.dataset_size: 152 3D ultrasound scans from 10 preterm infants; 230 manually segmented ventricles (108 training, 122 validation)

33560889.clinical_problem: assessing bone age in children living at high altitude (Tibet) using an AI system developed on a different population
33560889.model_description: A previously reported fully-automated AI bone-age system, trained on Han Chinese children from southern China, takes left-hand radiographs as input and outputs an estimated Greulich-Pyle bone age, compared with expert consensus reads.
33560889.headline_result: Accuracy within 1 year: 84.67% (Tibetan), 89.41% (Han); MAD 0.65 and 0.56 years respectively
33560889.study_design: retrospective external-population validation of an existing AI bone-age system

33637807.clinical_problem: differentiating pediatric high-grade brain tumor histology (tumor cellularity, necrosis, hemorrhage) noninvasively
33637807.patient_population: pediatric patients with high-grade brain tumors (sample size not stated in abstract)
33637807.model_description: A deep neural network takes diffusion basis spectrum imaging (DBSI)-derived diffusion metrics as input classifiers and outputs classification of tumor histology components (normal white matter, dense/less-dense tumor, infiltrating edge, necrosis, hemorrhage).
33637807.headline_result: Overall classification accuracy 85.8%; AUC 0.950-0.991 across tumor histology classes

33728035.clinical_problem: diagnosing pneumonia (and distinguishing bacterial from viral) in children from chest radiographs
33728035.patient_population: a widely used (relabeled) pediatric chest radiograph dataset
33728035.model_description: Statistical and deep-learning-derived global features are extracted from chest radiographs and combined for classification by a RandomForest classifier, outputting a three-class label (normal, bacterial pneumonia, viral pneumonia).
33728035.dataset_size: not stated (widely used relabeled chest radiograph dataset)
33728035.study_design: retrospective model-development study on a public dataset

33966055.clinical_problem: predicting 2-year neurodevelopmental outcome after neonatal encephalopathy from early diffusion MRI
33966055.patient_population: 15 term newborns with neonatal encephalopathy (5 normal, 5 abnormal motor outcome, 5 death)
33966055.model_description: A random forest classifier takes diffusion-weighted imaging connectome and fixel-based analysis metrics from MRI obtained in the first 4 weeks of life as input and predicts 2-year motor outcome category (normal, abnormal motor, death).

34063695.exclusion_reason: optical coherence tomography (OCT) of the middle ear; non-radiologic imaging modality excluded per protocol

34209154.clinical_problem: segmenting the fetus on MRI to aid diagnosis and clinical decision-making
34209154.model_description: Cross Attention Squeeze Excitation Network (CASE-Net) takes 2D fetal MR images as input and outputs whole-body fetal segmentation masks, combining attention mechanisms with squeeze-and-excitation blocks.

34319165.clinical_problem: whether FDA-cleared AI tools for medical imaging triage/detection/diagnosis are adequately developed and validated for use in children
34319165.patient_population: children broadly, as a population underrepresented in FDA-cleared AI imaging tools
34319165.model_description: A perspective/commentary reviewing the landscape of FDA-cleared AI imaging tools (over 100), noting only one is cleared for pediatric use, and proposing recommendations for adequate pediatric development and validation of AI tools.
34319165.headline_result: Only 1 of >100 FDA-cleared imaging AI tools is cleared for pediatric use

34405049.clinical_problem: detecting pediatric epilepsy from resting-state functional MRI
34405049.patient_population: 63 patients with epilepsy and 259 healthy controls undergoing preoperative rs-fMRI
34405049.model_description: Machine learning classifiers (XGBoost, SVM, random forest) take PCA-derived features of resting-state fMRI latency z-score maps as input and classify subjects as epilepsy vs. healthy control.
34405049.headline_result: Best model (XGBoost): test AUC 0.79, accuracy 74%, specificity 73%, sensitivity 77%

34470531.clinical_problem: screening for congenital anomalies of the fetal heart and lungs on ultrasound
34470531.patient_population: fetal ultrasound images (sample size not stated in abstract)
34470531.model_description: A multi-scale U-Net-style model with skip connections and additive attention gates takes fetal ultrasound images as input and simultaneously segments fetal heart and lung regions.
34470531.headline_result: Outperformed existing deep-learning segmentation methods (no single metric quoted in abstract)

34566556.clinical_problem: imputing missing longitudinal MRI scans in infants to complete developmental trajectory studies
34566556.patient_population: infants in the first year of life with longitudinal MRI (sample size not stated)
34566556.model_description: A 3D multi-contrast perceptual adversarial network (MPGAN) takes an infant's T1w/T2w MRI at one time point as input and predicts/imputes the structural MRI appearance at a different developmental time point using voxel-wise and perceptual losses.
34566556.headline_result: Imputed images improved downstream regression and classification task performance (no single accuracy figure reported)

34566613.clinical_problem: classifying developmental dyslexia from functional MRI and visualizing the brain regions driving classification
34566613.patient_population: children diagnosed with developmental dyslexia and typical readers (sample size not stated)
34566613.model_description: A convolutional neural network classifies subjects as dyslexic or typical readers from functional brain imaging features, with network-visualization techniques used to generate interpretable maps of discriminative brain regions.
34566613.study_design: retrospective classification study with model-interpretability analysis

34736625.clinical_problem: using muscle imaging (pattern recognition and quantification) to diagnose pediatric neuromuscular disease
34736625.patient_population: children with neuromuscular disorders (review, no single cohort)
34736625.model_description: A historical review of two decades of pediatric muscle imaging, describing progression from qualitative pattern recognition of MRI/ultrasound 'MRI fingerprints' toward quantification and machine learning approaches for etiological diagnosis.

34755674.clinical_problem: differentiating retroperitoneal neuroblastoma from ganglioneuroblastoma in children on CT
34755674.patient_population: 172 children with neuroblastoma and 48 with ganglioneuroblastoma
34755674.model_description: CT radiomics features are extracted from non-enhanced and post-enhanced images and combined in a multivariate regression model to output the probability of neuroblastoma vs. ganglioneuroblastoma.
34755674.study_design: retrospective radiomics model-development study with training/testing split

34850259.clinical_problem: triaging radiographs to detect and classify esophageal button-battery vs. coin foreign bodies in children
34850259.patient_population: training set of 57 radiographs; test set of 103 radiographs with a foreign body and 103 without
34850259.model_description: An object detector locates esophageal foreign bodies on radiographs, and an image classifier then classifies the detected object as a button battery or coin.
34850259.headline_result: Detector 100% sensitive/specific; classifier 100% button batteries and 97.9% coins correctly classified

34939745.clinical_problem: identifying epilepsy in children from diffusion kurtosis imaging of the hippocampus
34939745.patient_population: 59 children with hippocampal epilepsy and 70 age/sex-matched controls
34939745.model_description: An SVM classifier takes hippocampal kurtosis-tensor features derived from diffusion kurtosis imaging (DKI) as input and classifies subjects as epilepsy vs. normal control.

35967125.clinical_problem: segmenting white matter, gray matter and CSF on neonatal brain MRI acquired at different sites/scanners
35967125.patient_population: neonatal brain MRI from multiple sites, including a grand-challenge segmentation dataset (sample size not stated)
35967125.model_description: A CycleGAN harmonizes cross-site/cross-scanner neonatal brain MR images into the training-image domain (also reducing motion artifacts), after which a densely-connected U-Net segments white matter, gray matter and CSF.
35967125.headline_result: Better segmentation performance than existing methods on cross-site data and a grand-challenge dataset (no single metric reported in abstract)

30680611.exclusion_reason: adult-only study (community-dwelling older adults, mean age 72); not pediatric

31538277.clinical_problem: classifying conduct disorder in adolescents from structural brain MRI
31538277.patient_population: 60 adolescents with conduct disorder and 60 age/sex-matched healthy controls, all male
31538277.model_description: A 3D AlexNet CNN takes structural MRI as input and classifies adolescents as having conduct disorder vs. healthy, with saliency maps highlighting discriminative brain regions.
31538277.study_design: retrospective case-control classification study with 5-fold cross-validation

32086190.clinical_problem: predicting whether post-hemorrhagic hydrocephalus in premature neonates will require intervention, from cranial ultrasound
32086190.patient_population: premature neonates with post-hemorrhagic hydrocephalus (sample size not stated)
32086190.model_description: A deep-learning method (CNN incorporated into a probabilistic-atlas-based loss) segments lateral ventricles on cranial ultrasound to derive ventricular morphological phenotypes, which an SVM classifier then uses with clinical data to predict need for hydrocephalus intervention.

32337647.clinical_problem: automatically detecting scoliosis treatment (brace or implant) present on frontal radiographs
32337647.patient_population: 796 frontal radiographs of adolescents (84 brace, 325 implant, 387 no treatment), augmented to 2096 images
32337647.model_description: A CNN followed by discriminant analysis takes postero-anterior spine radiographs as input and outputs a probability of the image containing a brace, spinal implant, or no treatment.

32683551.clinical_problem: predicting neurodevelopmental outcome at 12 months in very preterm infants from MR spectroscopy and diffusion tensor imaging
32683551.patient_population: 300 very preterm infants (<32 weeks) scanned at term-equivalent age; 103-115 included after exclusions
32683551.model_description: Feed-forward neural networks take selected cerebral 1H-MR-spectroscopy metabolite ratios and diffusion tensor imaging metrics from six brain regions as input and predict motor and cognitive developmental delay at 12 months corrected age.

32748530.clinical_problem: establishing bone-age reference standards for Taiwanese children using automated software
32748530.model_description: BoneXpert automated software takes hand and wrist radiographs as input and outputs Greulich-Pyle and Tanner-Whitehouse 3 bone-age estimates, compared against chronological age.

32748530.headline_result: GP and TW3 bone age deviated from chronological age by varying amounts across age/sex subgroups (reference tables established, no single summary statistic)

32927234.exclusion_reason: conventional fMRI activation/behavioral analysis; no machine learning or AI component described

32955457.body_region: radius, distal tibia, proximal tibia, distal femur, calcaneus
32955457.clinical_problem: estimating chronological age from bone-age-assessment stage and non-radiological factors in young individuals, for legal/clinical age determination
32955457.model_description: Machine learning models take MRI-based bone-development staging (radiologist-assessed) plus weight, height and questionnaire data (Tanner scale, activity level, origin, residence) as input and output an estimated chronological age or minor/adult classification.
32955457.headline_result: Minor vs. adult classification accuracy 0.90 (male), 0.84 (female); CA estimation MAE 0.95 y (male), 1.24 y (female)

33018319.clinical_problem: automated early detection of juvenile myoclonic epilepsy from diffusion MRI
33018319.model_description: CNN-based transfer learning models (Inception_v3, Inception_v4, Inception_resnet_v2) take connectivity matrices derived from HARDI and NODDI diffusion MRI as input and classify subjects as JME vs. normal.

33048183.clinical_problem: classifying severity of liver stiffness (chronic liver disease) in children and young adults without MR elastography
33048183.patient_population: 273 subjects with known or suspected chronic liver disease (178 internal cross-validation, 95 external validation)
33048183.model_description: DeepLiverNet, a deep transfer learning model, takes T2-weighted MRI images plus clinical/demographic data as input and classifies liver stiffness as no/mild vs. moderate/severe, referenced against MR elastography.
33048183.headline_result: Internal AuROC 0.86, accuracy 88.0%; external validation AuROC 0.79, accuracy 80.0%

32547892.model_family: multivariate data-driven models with stability selection (feature selection); graph mining
32547892.clinical_problem: Predicting delayed neurocognitive effects (attention, memory, processing speed) after therapy for childhood acute lymphoblastic leukemia, early using imaging

29851653.clinical_problem: Fully automated classification of trunk tissues (lung, fat, muscle, solid organ, blood/bowel contrast, bone) on contrast-enhanced CT, including distinguishing bone from contrast
29851653.patient_population: Contrast-enhanced NCAP CT scans from adult and pediatric patients

29107355.clinical_problem: Reducing shadowing artifact in 3D fetal brain ultrasound to improve visibility of brain structures for monitoring and diagnosis of brain defects

29107355.model_description: An SVM trained on textural features assigns weights (posterior probabilities of brain tissue vs. shadow) used to spatially compound multiple 3D fetal head ultrasound projections into a single clearer volume

29226176.clinical_problem: Segmenting the lung across the breathing cycle on cine MRI to track respiratory muscle involvement in Duchenne muscular dystrophy

29250565.clinical_problem: Automating the initial rough alignment step of image-guided cochlear implant programming by localizing anatomical landmarks on head CT

26894329.clinical_problem: Improving the reliability of 2D/3D image registration used for daily patient setup verification in pediatric brain-tumor proton/external beam radiotherapy

26142928.clinical_problem: Stitching multiple overlapping fetal/obstetric ultrasound volumes into one accurate composite despite fetal movement

22723038.clinical_problem: Improving estimated fetal weight accuracy specifically for extreme macrosomia (>=4500 g) where standard formulas perform poorly

37427350.clinical_problem: detecting and characterizing pulmonary nodules on chest CT in adolescent and young adult osteosarcoma patients, for metastasis surveillance

37496480.clinical_problem: forensic age assessment (above/below 18 years) using knee CT images

37496480.model_description: Takes knee joint CT images as input, scoring epiphyseal synostosis stages, and outputs a binary classification of age above or below 18 years using convolutional neural network ensembles.

37508809.clinical_problem: automated segmentation of amniotic fluid on fetal MRI to quantify amniotic fluid volume for diagnosing fetal abnormalities

37652583.clinical_problem: automatically localizing anatomic landmarks on the pons and vermis in fetal brain MRI to assist measurement for detecting perinatal developmental disorders

37652583.model_description: Takes sagittal single-shot T2-weighted fetal brain MRI images as input and outputs automatically identified anatomic landmarks on the pons and vermis with a confidence score, using a U-Net deep learning model, to assist measurement.

37892275.clinical_problem: distinguishing pediatric adnexal torsion from acute appendicitis using clinical presentation and ultrasound findings

37903546.clinical_problem: predicting curve progression in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis patients being managed with bracing, at first clinic visit

37923758.clinical_problem: estimating patient body height and weight from CT localizer (scout) images in pediatric patients
37923758.patient_population: 1009-1111 pediatric CT localizers (training), 116-127 (validation), 203-225 (test); plus adult cohort added to training

37944709.clinical_problem: identifying pre-pandemic brain structural (and sleep) predictors of persistently high psychological stress in early adolescents during COVID-19

37971681.clinical_problem: predicting postmenstrual age from neonatal brain MRI to derive a brain maturation index reflecting developmental status

38113805.body_region: fetal heart (among other body regions in other benchmark datasets)

36093771.exclusion_reason: Classifies adolescent idiopathic scoliosis severity from lumbosacral joint efforts during gait (biomechanical data), explicitly proposed as a radiation-free alternative to radiography; no radiologic imaging is used as model input.

36523363.exclusion_reason: Diagnostic model based on phonocardiogram (heart sound audio recordings), not radiologic imaging; the 'optical coherence tomography network' is only the name of the classifier architecture, not an imaging modality used.

36685346.exclusion_reason: Review of retinal/fundus imaging, OCT, and telemedicine for retinopathy of prematurity; non-radiologic (ophthalmic) imaging.

36699518.clinical_problem: Building a predictive neurotypicality score from brain functional connectivity to help identify atypical neurodevelopment in children and adolescents

36699518.model_description: An ensemble of GAN discriminators trained on neurotypical resting-state fMRI functional connectivity patterns produces a predictive neurotypicality score three years after scanning, with LIME used to identify explanatory functional hubs.

36798853.model_family: CNN (custom architecture combining MRI volumes, radiomics, and feature maps)
36798853.clinical_problem: Predicting before delivery whether placenta accreta spectrum will be severe enough to require emergency hysterectomy
36798853.patient_population: 241 pregnant patients with placenta accreta spectrum
36798853.model_description: A convolutional network architecture (CascadeNet) combines MRI volumes, radiomic features, and custom feature maps to predict whether placenta accreta spectrum will require hysterectomy after fetal delivery.

36962760.exclusion_reason: Gestational age estimation from newborn screening metabolites (blood test panel); laboratory-based model, not radiologic imaging.

39911317.model_family: CNN (U-Net-like architecture with a context encoding module)
39911317.clinical_problem: Automatically segmenting cranial bones and localizing craniofacial landmarks from CT or MR images to support craniofacial analysis
39911317.patient_population: 274 pediatric subjects with diverse craniofacial conditions
39911317.model_description: A U-Net-like network with a novel context encoding module jointly performs single-stage cranial bone labeling (segmentation) and craniofacial landmark localization from CT (or MR) images, with an auxiliary task modeling the spatial configuration between landmarks.

33616744.exclusion_reason: Adult study (127 young women) using conventional regression analysis relating cortical thickness to heart-rate variability; no AI/ML method, not pediatric.

33968311.exclusion_reason: General review of COVID-19 clinical/radiological discrepancies across all ages; AI-based CXR algorithms and pediatric MRI safety are each mentioned only in passing, not the focus.

34101118.model_family: support vector machine (best of nine machine-learning models tested; radiomics-based)
34101118.clinical_problem: Predicting the causative bacterial class (Gram-positive, Gram-negative, or atypical) of pediatric bacterial pneumonia from low-dose chest CT to guide empirical antibiotic therapy
34101118.patient_population: 389 children with pathogen-confirmed bacterial pneumonia (122 Gram-positive, 159 Gram-negative, 108 atypical)
34101118.model_description: Radiomics features extracted from low-dose chest CT images are used to build three machine-learning submodels (Gram-positive, Gram-negative, atypical) that are integrated into a support-vector-machine-based multi-class classifier predicting the causative bacterial class of pneumonia.
34101118.dataset_size: 389 children (122 Gram-positive, 159 Gram-negative, 108 atypical bacterial pneumonia)
34101118.study_design: retrospective radiomics model development with internal train/test split

34101855.clinical_problem: Detecting small lumbar stress lesions on 99mTc-MDP SPECT bone scans in pediatric patients with low back pain, compared with physician performance

34101855.model_description: A deep CNN trained on 2.5D views extracted from simulated lesion-present and lesion-absent 99mTc-MDP SPECT images is applied in a sliding-window fashion to generate a 3D heatmap of lesion probability at each lumbar location, compared against physician localization performance in an LROC study.

34101855.headline_result: AUC-LROC 0.830 (deep learning) vs 0.785 (average of five physicians)
34101855.study_design: retrospective algorithm development with cross-validation and a physician reader-comparison (LROC) study

34130195.exclusion_reason: Feasibility study of CNNs for detecting malformations of cortical development on MRI; the abstract does not state a pediatric population or age range.

34303948.exclusion_reason: Adult population (346 male inpatient cocaine users) studying retrospectively recalled childhood trauma via questionnaires and machine learning; no imaging, not pediatric radiology.

34605964.model_family: deep learning CT reconstruction (six manufacturer-standard DLR algorithms)
34605964.clinical_problem: Comparing deep-learning CT image reconstruction to standard iterative reconstruction for detecting urinary tract stones in children and young adults on unenhanced CT
34605964.patient_population: 14 patients (mean age 17.3 ± 3.4 years, 5 males, 9 females), reconstructed into 84 total exams
34605964.model_description: Six manufacturer-standard deep-learning CT reconstruction algorithms were applied to clinically acquired unenhanced abdomen/pelvis CT scans, and three blinded radiologists identified and measured urinary tract stones on the reconstructed images, compared against standard iterative reconstruction as a reference.

34605964.study_design: retrospective post-hoc reconstruction study with blinded reader comparison to a reference standard

34647145.exclusion_reason: Adult population (214 patients with chronic liver disease/cirrhosis); predictive model uses clinical laboratory values (bilirubin, albumin, MELD-Na, Child-Pugh score), not radiologic image features, and no pediatric population stated.

34712295.exclusion_reason: Title references an SVM algorithm, but the abstract describes only conventional statistical analysis (chi-square test, multivariate logistic regression) of clinical and Doppler ultrasound findings in gestational diabetes; no machine-learning methodology or results are reported.

34717846.exclusion_reason: Review of ultrashort/zero echo-time pediatric bone MR imaging technique and clinical applications (craniosynostosis, sinonasal/jaw imaging, trauma); deep learning is mentioned only in passing as one of three approaches to synthetic CT generation, not the review's focus.

34883946.model_family: CNN (residual CNN localization + boundary-preserving fully convolutional dense nets)
34883946.clinical_problem: Automatically segmenting the kidney and its cortex/medulla compartments from pediatric dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI to compute markers of kidney function such as glomerular filtration rate
34883946.patient_population: 60 4D DCE-MRI volumes from pediatric patients with varying conditions affecting kidney function
34883946.model_description: A dual-stage deep-learning framework first localizes and segments each kidney using residual convolutional neural networks with spatial-temporal, boundary-preserving fully convolutional dense nets, then further segments the cortex and medulla to compute quantitative kidney-function markers from 4D DCE-MRI.
34883946.headline_result: 3.8% higher mean Dice similarity coefficient than a state-of-the-art comparison method (GrabCut + SVM)
34883946.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and internal evaluation on a pediatric DCE-MRI dataset

32089729.model_family: random forest classification + Gaussian mixture model (probabilistic point-cloud registration)
32089729.clinical_problem: Automatically registering 3D fetal brain ultrasound volumes affected by acoustic occlusion and noise, to monitor fetal brain growth and support brain-atlas-based segmentation
32089729.patient_population: 3D ultrasound fetal brain volumes (exact n not stated)
32089729.model_description: A supervised-learning-guided variant of the coherent point drift algorithm uses random-forest classification to weight a point cloud and assign Gaussian mixture model membership probabilities, enabling automatic registration of 3D fetal head ultrasound volumes despite occlusion artifacts and noise.
32089729.headline_result: target registration error 6.38 ± 3.24 mm; error reduction of 7.4%-60.7% versus comparison algorithms

32757145.exclusion_reason: Case series describing clinical and lung ultrasound findings in aspiration pneumonia in children; no AI/ML component.

33236529.exclusion_reason: Adult population with HBV-related liver cirrhosis and covert hepatic encephalopathy; not pediatric.

33564753.clinical_problem: Automatically segmenting subcortical brain structures on infant brain MRI to study early subcortical growth patterns and related disease diagnosis
33564753.model_description: A coarse-to-fine two-stage CNN framework: a signed-distance-map-predicting U-Net (SDM-UNet) first learns spatial context (relative position and shape) from multi-modal T1w, T2w, and T1w/T2w images, then a multi-source multi-path U-Net (M2-UNet) combines this with the images to deliver refined subcortical segmentation.
33564753.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and evaluation compared with four state-of-the-art methods

33598664.model_family: semi-supervised transfer learning (deep learning, confidence-map guided)
33598664.clinical_problem: Segmenting the infant cerebellum into white matter, gray matter, and cerebrospinal fluid from MRI across ages 6-24 months despite low tissue contrast in younger infants
33598664.model_description: A semi-supervised transfer-learning framework, guided by a confidence map, propagates reliable manual cerebellum tissue labels from high-contrast 24-month-old infant MRI to progressively segment lower-contrast MRI from 18-, 12-, and 6-month-old infants.
33598664.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and comparison with state-of-the-art methods

30693378.exclusion_reason: General strategic research agenda for biomedical imaging across all of medicine; AI/machine learning is mentioned only briefly as one of several topics, not pediatric-specific.

30824170.exclusion_reason: Review of CT versus ultrasound strategy for acute abdominal pain/appendicitis across all ages; no AI/ML component.

31843832.clinical_problem: Assessing whether automated 3D ultrasound image-recognition software can reduce variability in fetal biometric measurements (head/abdominal circumference, femur length) used to estimate gestational age and monitor fetal growth
31843832.model_description: Automated software extracts standard reference planes from 3D ultrasound volumes of the fetal head, abdomen, and femur and computes biometric measurements automatically, to be compared with manual 2D ultrasound measurements for agreement and reproducibility.
31843832.study_design: prospective cross-sectional study protocol (trial registration NCT03812471)

31856250.exclusion_reason: The SVM classifier for identifying yawns was developed and tested on video-based behavioral coding of preterm neonates' mouth movements, not on ultrasound images; the intended future application to fetal ultrasound is discussed but not implemented or tested here.

32924031.model_family: neural network classifier (with regional-MRI-feature-substitution data augmentation)
32924031.clinical_problem: Predicting whether adolescents will transition from no/low to medium/heavy alcohol drinking based on volumetric brain MRI measurements
32924031.model_description: A data-augmentation strategy that synthetically substitutes regional brain MRI volume scores generates over one million synthetic training samples from fewer than 500 subjects, used to train a neural-network classifier predicting adolescent alcohol-use transition from volumetric MRI measurements.
32924031.dataset_size: fewer than 500 subjects, augmented to over one million synthetic samples
32924031.headline_result: 74.1% accuracy distinguishing non-drinkers from drinkers at baseline; 43.2% weighted accuracy predicting the 3-year transition (5-group classification)
32924031.study_design: retrospective algorithm development with data augmentation and 20-fold cross-validation

34278384.clinical_problem: Predicting missing longitudinal infant diffusion MRI data to fill gaps caused by subject dropout or unsuccessful scans, for studying brain microstructure development
34278384.patient_population: longitudinally acquired pediatric diffusion MRI dataset (exact n not stated)
34278384.model_description: A graph convolutional network jointly models spatial (x-space) and diffusion-angular (q-space) relationships as a graph, using a residual learning architecture to predict longitudinal changes in infant diffusion MRI data over time and fill missing timepoints.

29858509.exclusion_reason: Open-source model-based iterative CT reconstruction using coordinate-descent optimization; a classical optimization algorithm, not a machine-learning method, and the pediatric thoracic scan is only one incidental test case rather than the study's focus.

30035016.exclusion_reason: Group-comparison graph-theoretical network analysis of structural MRI in children with epilepsy; conventional statistical analysis of network metrics, not a machine-learning predictive model.

30396518.exclusion_reason: Workshop report covering placental imaging research broadly (blood flow, multimodal imaging, segmentation methods, public engagement); deep learning fetal MRI segmentation is mentioned only in passing as one of about 20 poster topics, not the report's focus.

30654905.exclusion_reason: Data mining of clinical/laboratory records (not image-based AI) to analyze the cardiac effects of childhood rheumatic fever; chest x-ray findings ('teleNormal', 'cardiomegaly') are used only as an input attribute label, not analyzed by AI.

28251155.model_family: 3D Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) with sliding-window scoring
28251155.clinical_problem: Automatically localizing the fetal brain in 3T MRI acquired as motion-affected 2D slice stacks, to enable large-scale automated fetal MRI processing and motion correction
28251155.patient_population: 104 fetal MRI scans, gestational ages 34-38 weeks
28251155.model_description: A 3D extension of the Histogram of Oriented Gradients feature descriptor scores candidate windows in a sliding-window search to automatically localize the fetal brain in motion-affected 3T MRI slice stacks, supporting downstream fetal motion correction and reconstruction.
28251155.study_design: retrospective algorithm development with leave-one-out cross-validation, compared against template matching and random forest regression

26802942.exclusion_reason: Title mentions 'youth' but the study population is described only as 'healthy subjects' with MeSH terms Adult/Young Adult; no pediatric age range is stated.

25954186.model_description: Brain activation features from conflict-related functional MRI contrast images, plus Granger causality connectivity indices among brain regions, are used to train a support vector machine classifying adolescents by familial history of substance use disorder.
25954186.headline_result: classification accuracy up to 97.28% (leave-one-out cross-validation, combined activity and connectivity features)
25954186.study_design: retrospective case-control classification study with leave-one-out cross-validation

21097097.model_family: Hopfield Neural Network (hybrid with Bayesian classifier)
21097097.clinical_problem: Automatically segmenting the neonatal skull on MRI to support source localization of EEG/MEG signals
21097097.model_description: A hybrid algorithm combining a Bayesian classifying framework with a Hopfield Neural Network, using locally adaptive statistical parameters to handle non-homogeneous skull intensities, segments the skull on high-resolution T1-weighted neonatal MRI.

19546330.clinical_problem: Assessing the feasibility of automated 3D ultrasound software for extended basic fetal cardiac screening in routine prenatal ultrasound practice
19546330.patient_population: 126 pregnant women in the second trimester (107 successful cardiac volume acquisitions)
19546330.model_description: SonoVCAD, a commercial sonography-based volume computer-aided diagnosis software (GE Healthcare), automatically extracts standard diagnostic fetal cardiac planes (4-chamber view, left and right ventricular outflow tracts, stomach) from a single acquired 3D cardiac ultrasound volume.

19546330.study_design: prospective feasibility study in routine clinical ultrasound practice

20033591.body_region: abdomen and thorax (spine, diaphragm, pelvis, to assist neuroblastoma tumor segmentation)
20033591.clinical_problem: Automatically identifying anatomical landmarks (vertebral column, spinal canal, diaphragm, pelvic girdle) on pediatric CT to assist automatic segmentation of neuroblastoma tumors
20033591.patient_population: 4 pediatric patients with neuroblastoma (10 CT exams)
20033591.model_description: Automated image-processing algorithms identify and segment abdominal and thoracic anatomical landmarks (ribs, vertebral column, spinal canal, diaphragm, pelvic girdle) on pediatric CT images to constrain and assist subsequent automatic segmentation of neuroblastic tumors.
20033591.headline_result: 22.4% average reduction in false-positive tumor segmentation error rate
20033591.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and evaluation compared with manual radiologist segmentation

18196306.clinical_problem: Improving the accuracy of estimated fetal weight from ultrasound biometry by detecting and correcting measurement errors in real time
18196306.patient_population: 4075 women in labor (model training/testing); 61 women in the last week of pregnancy (clinical protocol testing)
18196306.model_description: A multinormal probability model, whose parameters are estimated by feed-forward artificial neural networks trained on pregnancy data, checks and corrects real-time ultrasound echobiometric measurements to improve estimated fetal weight accuracy.
18196306.study_design: prospective clinical evaluation of a retrospectively developed neural-network-based probability model

18302119.exclusion_reason: Narrative review of transcranial magnetic stimulation technique and neurophysiology across neurology and psychiatry; no imaging AI component, not pediatric-specific.

16176788.model_family: multivariate texture classifier (gray-level co-occurrence matrix based)
16176788.clinical_problem: Enhancing neonatal cranial ultrasound images to improve visual detection and boundary delineation of periventricular leukomalacia

41511488.exclusion_reason: Machine learning is used only to estimate environmental exposure levels (air pollution, temperature) from residential addresses; cardiovascular imaging parameters are obtained by standard echocardiography and analyzed with conventional statistics, not AI-based image analysis.

41673142.body_region: multiple (radiography, CT, MRI, DEXA, ultrasound across various body regions)
41673142.clinical_problem: Evaluating how much AI models trained on adult imaging data lose performance when applied to pediatric imaging without adaptation, across modalities, tasks and age groups
41673142.patient_population: 16 pediatric imaging dataset cohorts across 20 included studies, ranging from 30 to 7,357 subjects
41673142.model_description: A scoping review of 20 studies evaluating adult-trained AI radiology tools (radiography, CT, MRI, DEXA, ultrasound; segmentation, classification, detection, and mixed tasks) applied to pediatric imaging without retraining, quantifying the resulting performance degradation by modality, task and age group.
41673142.headline_result: pulmonary nodule detection sensitivity dropped from 68-100% (adults) to 26-68% (children); segmentation Dice score reductions >0.10 across organs and modalities; greatest deficits in children 2 years old or younger

42013743.model_name: BIBSNet (Baby and Infant Brain Segmentation Neural Network)
42013743.clinical_problem: Automatically segmenting infant brain tissue on MRI to support studies of typical and atypical early brain development
42013743.model_description: BIBSNet, an open-source deep neural network trained using manually annotated real images plus synthetic segmentations (SynthSeg) with a 10-fold procedure, performs infant brain tissue segmentation that outperforms joint label fusion and is faster at inference, producing FreeSurfer-compatible labels.

42013743.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and validation against joint label fusion and iBEAT segmentation

39052464.clinical_problem: Automatically and reproducibly measuring cervical length on transvaginal ultrasound to screen for preterm birth risk

39052464.model_description: CL-Net, a deep-learning network that incorporates expert anatomical knowledge to identify the cervical canal (a thin, low-contrast structure) on transvaginal ultrasound, automatically and reproducibly measures cervical length to screen for preterm birth risk.

39052464.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and evaluation against expert and non-expert measurements

39266284.exclusion_reason: Machine learning is applied to plasma lipidomics data to predict neurofilament light chain levels in pediatric-onset multiple sclerosis; MRI lesion counts are used only as a clinical outcome in standard regression analysis, not as AI-analyzed images.

39532533.clinical_problem: Automatically removing facial identifying features from pediatric brain MRI scans (defacing) to enable safe data sharing for pediatric neuroimaging research while preserving research-relevant brain measures

39532533.dataset_size: 976 images from 244 patients (208 brain tumor, 36 clinical control), ages 7 days-21 years

39793007.model_family: large language / vision-language model (ChatGPT) versus specialized deep-learning classifiers
39793007.clinical_problem: Comparing ChatGPT's ability to detect pneumonia on pediatric chest X-rays against specialized AI models
39793007.model_description: The study compares ChatGPT's performance detecting pneumonia on pediatric chest radiographs against specialized AI models trained for that task; no further methodological detail is available because the abstract text was not provided in this record.

39818132.model_family: neural network-based methods (attention/saliency, coarse-to-fine, dilated convolution, GANs, spatio-temporal)

39818132.patient_population: review of the fetal echocardiography machine-learning literature (48 papers reviewed in detail)
39818132.model_description: A scoping review of 48 papers on neural-network-based methods for fetal heart anatomy classification and segmentation in fetal echocardiography, covering techniques such as attention/saliency, coarse-to-fine refinement, dilated convolution, generative adversarial networks, and spatio-temporal modeling.

39866856.exclusion_reason: Intraoperative Raman spectroscopy tissue classification for neurosurgical guidance (optical spectroscopy, not radiologic imaging); the model was developed on a primarily adult cohort, with only one pediatric glioblastoma sample used to test generalizability.

39881022.headline_result: ICC 0.83-0.88 for synthetic image measurements (vs 0.93-0.99 for real images); correlations between real and synthetic parameters 0.17-0.74; mean absolute errors 7-9 degrees for angular measures and 1.1 cm for sagittal vertical axis; image quality judged insufficient for clinical parameter assessment except for sagittal vertical axis
39881022.study_design: retrospective GAN model development and evaluation against real paired radiographs

39906903.model_family: various machine-learning algorithms (systematic review of 26 studies)
39906903.clinical_problem: Reviewing machine-learning models that predict neurodevelopmental impairment (cognitive, motor, language deficits) in very preterm infants using clinical, neuroimaging, and omics data
39906903.patient_population: very preterm infants (systematic review of 26 studies, January 2018-December 2023)
39906903.model_description: A systematic review of 26 studies applying machine-learning algorithms to clinical and neuroimaging data (and, increasingly, omics data) from very preterm infants to predict later neurodevelopmental impairment.

39931456.model_family: large language model (Gemma-7B) with a distilled BERT-based model
39931456.clinical_problem: Automatically labeling pediatric abdominal X-ray radiology reports for the presence and subtype (pneumatosis, portal venous gas, free air) of necrotizing enterocolitis, to support NEC research
