39931456.study_design: retrospective model development and evaluation against baseline BERT models

39952550.exclusion_reason: Temporomandibular joint MRI analysis published in a dental journal; TMJ disorder assessment falls within oral/maxillofacial (dental) practice, matching the 'dental' exclusion category rather than general pediatric radiology.

40021764.clinical_problem: Prenatal diagnosis of biliary atresia, a rare and severe congenital disorder that is challenging to detect before birth, from fetal ultrasound
40021764.patient_population: fetuses from 20 hospitals across China and infants from a public database; three independent test cohorts
40021764.model_description: A transfer-learning deep-learning model, pretrained and fine-tuned across multi-institutional fetal ultrasound data, predicts fetal biliary atresia and outperforms both a basic deep-learning model and individual sonologists when used as a diagnostic aid.
40021764.dataset_size: multi-institutional fetal cohort from 20 hospitals plus a public infant database (exact n not stated); three independent test cohorts
40021764.headline_result: AUC 0.906, 0.914, 0.907 across three independent test cohorts (vs 0.793, 0.790, 0.880 for the basic deep-learning model)

40024623.clinical_problem: Reviewing the use of artificial intelligence and radiomics in fetal ultrasound imaging
40024623.model_description: A review of the literature on artificial intelligence and radiomics applications in fetal ultrasound, with future perspectives; no further detail is available because the abstract text was not provided in this record.

40036245.clinical_problem: Evaluating whether functional connectivity of dopamine-related brain regions on fMRI can serve as a diagnostic biomarker and subtyping tool for autism spectrum disorder in children

38402375.model_family: machine learning (classification and regression models, algorithm unspecified)
38402375.clinical_problem: Identifying brain structural and connectivity correlates of emotion regulation ability in children at high risk for autism spectrum disorder
38402375.patient_population: 55 children at high risk of autism spectrum disorder, 52 typically developing children
38402375.model_description: Machine learning classification and regression models relate structural MRI/diffusion tensor imaging-derived white matter fiber bundle connectivity and amygdala/hippocampus volumes to emotion regulation behaviors in children at high risk of autism spectrum disorder.
38402375.dataset_size: 55 high-risk ASD children, 52 typically developing children
38402375.headline_result: R2 0.245 (right amygdala volume) and 0.667 (white matter connectivity predicting mother-seeking behavior) for emotion regulation strategies
38402375.study_design: Retrospective case-control neuroimaging study with machine learning models

38415463.clinical_problem: Automatically measuring scoliosis Cobb angle on spine radiographs
38415463.patient_population: 481 spine radiographs (open-source dataset, train/validation) and 119 spine radiographs from a private dataset (test), pediatric and adolescent scoliosis patients
38415463.model_description: Two deep learning Cobb angle assessment models (Seg4Reg, a segmentation-based regression model, and VFLDN, a keypoint-based landmark detection model) automatically measure spinal curvature on radiographs, compared against manual physician measurement.
38415463.dataset_size: 481 spine radiographs (open dataset, train/validation); 119 radiographs (private dataset, test)
38415463.headline_result: VFLDN: ICC 0.974, PCC 0.952 vs manual (MAD 2.36 deg); Seg4Reg: ICC 0.809, PCC 0.731 (MAD 6.51 deg)
38415463.study_design: Retrospective external validation and clinical application study

38426209.clinical_problem: Automating bone age assessment for Han and Tibetan children, including in resource-limited high-altitude settings
38426209.patient_population: RSNA and RHPE public datasets plus a local Han/Tibetan children dataset (825 train, 351 test: 216 Han, 135 Tibetan); external test set of 256 Tibetan children
38426209.model_description: EVG-BANet, a deep learning bone age assessment model trained on RSNA and RHPE datasets plus a local Han/Tibetan children dataset, is compared against the open-source BoNet model across multiple test sets including an external all-Tibetan cohort.
38426209.dataset_size: RSNA (12,611/1,425/200 train/val/test); RHPE (5,491/713/79); local dataset (825 train, 351 test); external Tibetan test set (n=256)
38426209.headline_result: MAD 0.52-0.53 years (RHPE, external Tibetan test sets) vs BoNet 0.63-0.66 years; accuracy within 1 year 97.7% local, 89.5% external
38426209.study_design: Retrospective model development with external validation

38490997.exclusion_reason: Animal (rhesus monkey) study of infant temperament and brain metabolism; not a human pediatric radiology study.

38522222.clinical_problem: Detecting polymicrogyria, a subtle cortical malformation, on pediatric brain MRI
38522222.patient_population: Children with polymicrogyria and controls from the Children's Hospital of Eastern Ontario (PPMR dataset)
38522222.model_description: A center-based deep contrastive metric learning anomaly-detection method flags pediatric brain MRIs likely to show polymicrogyria, intended as a computer-aided screening tool for radiologists; code and a new open pediatric MRI dataset (PPMR) are released publicly.
38522222.release_evidence: Our code is available at: https://github.com/RichardChangCA/... ; dataset available at kaggle.com/datasets/lingfengzhang/pediatric-polymicrogyria-mri-dataset
38522222.dataset_size: Small, imbalanced pediatric MRI dataset (PPMR; exact N not stated in abstract)
38522222.study_design: Retrospective model development study, first ML application to detect polymicrogyria from MRI

38605540.exclusion_reason: Phantom-based contrast-media dose-reduction study for CT (adult and pediatric size phantoms); deep learning reconstruction is used as one of two reconstruction techniques compared, incidental to the primary iodine-CNR optimization methodology, and no clinical patients are studied.

38653568.model_family: radiomics + multivariate logistic regression / random forest
38653568.clinical_problem: Predicting which neuroblastic tumors are high-risk neuroblastoma using MRI radiomics
38653568.patient_population: 32 patients (training, institution A) and 14 patients (external test, institution B), age <=18 years
38653568.model_description: Radiomics features (n=930) extracted from manually segmented pre-treatment MRI tumor regions feed multivariate logistic regression and random forest models (10-fold cross-validated) that predict high-risk neuroblastoma status; models were tested on an external institution's cohort.
38653568.headline_result: MLR model AUC 0.94 training and test; random forest AUC 0.83 (training CV), 0.91 (test)
38653568.study_design: Retrospective pilot study with external test set

38672556.clinical_problem: Differentiating medulloblastoma from pilocytic astrocytoma, the two most common pediatric brain tumors, preoperatively
38672556.patient_population: 195 preoperative MRIs from children with medulloblastoma (n=69) or pilocytic astrocytoma (n=126) across six university hospitals
38672556.model_description: A patch-based 3D-DenseNet deep learning classifier, using automated tumor segmentation and all individually available preoperative MRI sequences, differentiates medulloblastoma from pilocytic astrocytoma and is compared against five human readers of varying experience.
38672556.dataset_size: 195 preoperative MRIs (69 medulloblastoma, 126 pilocytic astrocytoma) from six university hospitals; 64-patient test set
38672556.headline_result: AUC 0.986; 62/64 (97%) correct diagnoses in test set; on par with pediatric neuro-oncology experts, better than inexperienced readers (p<0.05)
38672556.study_design: Retrospective multicenter proof-of-concept diagnostic accuracy study

38704285.model_family: machine learning (AdaBoost, KNN, SVM with SHAP explainability)
38704285.clinical_problem: Differentiating early-onset schizophrenia from early-onset bipolar disorder using brain MRI surface morphometry
38704285.patient_population: 144 adolescents (mean age 16.2+/-1.4 years): 81 with early-onset schizophrenia, 63 with early-onset bipolar disorder
38704285.model_description: Explainable machine learning classifiers (AdaBoost, KNN, SVM) using T1-weighted MRI-derived cortical thickness, gyrification, sulcal depth, fractal dimension, and brain volume features, interpreted via SHAP, differentiate early-onset schizophrenia from early-onset bipolar disorder.
38704285.headline_result: AdaBoost accuracy 82.75% (Destrieux atlas, all variables); KNN accuracy 79.31% (Desikan-Killiany-Tourville atlas)

38730032.clinical_problem: Predicting postnatal enlarged lateral ventricle outcomes in fetuses with isolated ventriculomegaly from a single prenatal MRI
38730032.patient_population: 141 normal fetuses, 101 fetuses with ventriculomegaly (68 resolved, 33 stable), 2014-2023
38730032.model_description: Logistic regression models (5-fold cross-validated) using lateral ventricle morphology and cortical/subcortical radiomics features from a single fetal MRI predict postnatal lateral ventricle alterations in fetuses with isolated ventriculomegaly.
38730032.headline_result: Subcortical-radiomics model distinguishing normal vs ventriculomegaly fetuses: AUC 1/0.992 (train/val); predicting postnatal alteration: AUC 0.822/0.743 (train/val)

38766538.clinical_problem: Segmenting the fetal head on ultrasound for prenatal biometric measurement
38766538.patient_population: not stated (described as the largest dataset to date for fetal head metrics)
38766538.model_description: FetSAM is a prompt-based deep learning segmentation model for fetal head ultrasound images, using a dual loss (weighted Dice + weighted Lovasz) and benchmarked against U-Net, DeepLabV3, and Segformer.
38766538.dataset_size: Largest fetal head ultrasound dataset to date (exact N not stated)
38766538.headline_result: Dice 0.90117, Hausdorff distance 1.86484, average surface distance 0.46645
38766538.study_design: Retrospective model development and benchmarking study

38772798.clinical_problem: Predicting macrolide-resistance-associated gene mutation status in children with Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia from chest CT
38772798.patient_population: 258 pediatric MPP patients (194 training at institution 1, 64 external test at institution 2)
38772798.model_description: Radiomics features from semi-automatically segmented pulmonary lesions on chest CT are used in logistic regression and random forest models to predict 23S rRNA gene mutation status (macrolide resistance) in children with Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia.
38772798.dataset_size: 258 patients (194 training, 64 external test), two institutions
38772798.headline_result: Logistic regression AUC 0.868 (train), 0.855 (external test); random forest AUC 0.941 (train), 0.815 (external test)
38772798.study_design: Retrospective two-center model development and external validation study

38781934.clinical_problem: Detecting congenital heart defects on fetal ultrasound to improve early detection rates beyond the current ~60%
38781934.model_description: Review of deep-learning-based fetal ultrasound image evaluation techniques (preprocessing, localization, segmentation, classification, including CNN-based denoising and CNN/ANN-based segmentation) for detecting congenital heart defects.

38786405.clinical_problem: Detecting wrist fractures in children from infrared thermal imaging as an alternative/adjunct to X-ray
38786405.patient_population: 40 participants (19 with wrist fracture, 21 with sprain), diagnosis confirmed by X-ray
38786405.model_description: A 34-layer CNN classifies Fourier-transformed infrared thermal images of pediatric wrists (frequency-domain magnitude spectra) as fractured or non-fractured (sprain).
38786405.study_design: Retrospective pilot diagnostic model development study

38797384.exclusion_reason: Non-human primate (macaque, chimpanzee, marmoset, etc.) brain MRI processing toolbox; not a human pediatric radiology study.

38802611.clinical_problem: Assessing bone age in preschool children and reducing inter/intra-observer variability with AI assistance
38802611.patient_population: 94 preschool children aged 3-6 years (53 female, 41 male), China
38802611.model_description: An AI model system assists radiology reviewers performing bone age assessment (TW3 and RUS-CHN methods) on hand radiographs of preschool children; evaluated for its effect on inter- and intra-observer agreement rather than as a standalone diagnostic tool.
38802611.headline_result: ICC values exceeded 0.99 with AI assistance; RMSE/MAE significantly decreased with AI (p<0.001)
38802611.study_design: Retrospective reader study on observer variability with AI assistance

38831994.clinical_problem: Distinguishing children from adults with Mycoplasma pneumonia based on clinical, CT imaging, and radiomic features, and quantitatively representing CT imaging signs
38831994.patient_population: 981 Mycoplasma pneumonia patients (590 internal: 450 adults/140 children; 391 external test: 121 adults/270 children)
38831994.model_description: Combined clinical, CT-image, and radiomics (LASSO-selected from 1,904 extracted features) logistic regression models differentiate adult from pediatric Mycoplasma pneumonia cases and provide quantitative radiomic representations of qualitative CT signs.
38831994.study_design: Retrospective multi-cohort model development and external validation

38832703.clinical_problem: Predicting risk of scoliosis curve progression in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis based on bone microarchitecture phenotypes
38832703.patient_population: Primary cohort n=101 girls with AIS (followed 6.22+/-0.33 years); secondary cohort n=106 girls with mild AIS
38832703.model_description: Unsupervised machine learning (fuzzy C-means clustering) groups girls with adolescent idiopathic scoliosis into three bone microarchitecture phenotypes based on HR-pQCT parameters, which are then tested as predictors of curve-progression risk to surgical threshold.
38832703.dataset_size: Primary cohort n=101; secondary cohort n=106
38832703.headline_result: Phenotype 3: OR 4.88 (95%CI 1.03-28.63) for progression to surgical threshold; secondary cohort OR 5.39 (phenotype 2), 3.67 (phenotype 3) for progression >=6 degrees
38832703.study_design: Prospective longitudinal cohort study with unsupervised ML phenotyping

38841427.exclusion_reason: General-population MRI contrast-enhancement generative model (GAN); pregnant women and children are mentioned only as populations that could benefit from reduced contrast-agent use, not as the actual study population (dataset/cohort not described as pediatric).

38842257.exclusion_reason: Serum metabolomics study of pediatric Crohn disease inflammation; MR enterography is used only to define outcome measures (the PICMI index), not as AI model input, and the machine learning (random forest) model predicts from serum metabolite biomarkers, not from imaging.

38873982.clinical_problem: Assessing feasibility of automated fetal cardiac functional analysis (2D speckle-tracking echocardiography) for less experienced operators
38873982.patient_population: 136 normal singleton second- and third-trimester fetuses
38873982.model_description: FetalHQ, a semi-automated two-dimensional speckle-tracking echocardiography tool, calculates fetal cardiac functional and morphometric parameters (strain, fractional shortening, sphericity index) from ultrasound; compared between beginner and expert operators.
38873982.headline_result: Excellent inter-operator agreement for morphometry (ED, SI), good agreement for function (endoGLS, FS); Bland-Altman bias -4.24pp/-3.21pp for endoGLS

38899013.exclusion_reason: Automated classification of lung auscultation sounds (audio signals, not imaging) using deep learning; not a radiology imaging modality.

38902015.exclusion_reason: Standard fMRI group analysis of body image/self-concept development in adolescents; no AI/machine-learning imaging model is used.

38926172.clinical_problem: Automatically reconstructing 3D spine anatomy and measuring curvature parameters (Cobb angle, vertebral rotation, kyphosis, lordosis) from biplanar radiographs in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis
38926172.patient_population: 380 paired biplanar (EOS) radiographs of children with adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (304 pairs training, 76 pairs test)
38926172.model_description: An AI algorithm reconstructs a 3D scoliotic spine from paired posteroanterior and lateral EOS biplanar radiographs and automatically extracts curvature parameters (Cobb angle, apical vertebral rotation, kyphotic and lordotic angles), compared against manual measurement by an experienced rater.
38926172.headline_result: MAD 3.3 deg (Cobb angle), 1.5 deg (vertebral rotation), 3.3 deg (kyphotic angle), 3.5 deg (lordotic angle); 98% within clinical acceptance; ICC >0.94; reconstruction in 5.2+/-1.3s

38937304.clinical_problem: Differentiating benign from malignant, and among four etiologies of, cervical lymphadenopathy in children using MRI radiomics
38937304.patient_population: 419 cervical lymph nodes from 146 pediatric patients
38937304.model_description: Radiomic features (1,218 per lymph node) extracted from T2-weighted MRI, reduced via LASSO, feed support vector machine classifiers to distinguish benign from malignant cervical lymph nodes and to differentiate among four common etiologies (Kikuchi disease, reactive hyperplasia, suppurative lymphadenitis, malignancy).
38937304.dataset_size: 419 lymph nodes from 146 patients (7:3 train/test split)
38937304.headline_result: Benign vs malignant AUC 0.89 (train), 0.80 (test); four-etiology model AUC 0.87-0.97 (train), 0.80-0.96 (test)

38976189.exclusion_reason: Pneumonia classification model from chest X-rays; children are mentioned only as one at-risk population in the introduction, and the study population/dataset is not stated to be pediatric.

38991771.clinical_problem: Detecting skull fractures and evaluating cranial suture patency without ionizing radiation, using deep-learning pseudo-CT generated from MRI in children
38991771.patient_population: 72 patients younger than 18 (12 for suture patency evaluation, 60 for head trauma evaluation)
38991771.model_description: Automated motion correction is applied to MR imaging, followed by a deep-learning method that generates pseudo-CT images of the pediatric skull from MRI, evaluated for skull fracture detection and cranial suture patency assessment against ground-truth CT.
38991771.dataset_size: 72 patients (12 for suture patency, 60 for head trauma)
38991771.headline_result: Suture patency: 100% sensitivity/specificity; skull fracture detection: 100% specificity, 90% sensitivity

39018640.model_family: deep learning (knowledge distillation + contrastive regularization, scribble-supervised segmentation)
39018640.clinical_problem: Reducing annotation cost for placenta and fetal brain segmentation on fetal MRI using scribble (weak) annotations instead of full pixel-level labels
39018640.patient_population: not stated (fetal MRI dataset used as one of two benchmarks, alongside an adult cardiac MRI dataset)
39018640.model_description: ScribSD+ is a scribble-supervised segmentation framework (multi-scale knowledge distillation plus class-wise contrastive regularization) that learns to segment the placenta and fetal brain on fetal MRI (and cardiac structures on adult cardiac MRI) from scribble annotations instead of full pixel-level labels.
39018640.headline_result: Outperformed five state-of-the-art scribble-supervised segmentation methods (fetal-MRI-specific Dice not given in abstract)
39018640.study_design: Retrospective methods development and benchmarking study

39060444.clinical_problem: Forensic bone age assessment (determining whether a person is above or below legal age thresholds of 12/14/16/18) from hand and wrist MRI in Chinese Han males
39060444.model_description: A deep learning model extracts and enhances epiphyseal features from hand and wrist MRI to classify subjects into legal age categories (12/14/16/18-year thresholds) and regress a continuous bone age estimate.
39060444.headline_result: Adult vs minor classification accuracy 91.1%; minor age-threshold classification accuracy 91.1-96.4%; regression MAE 1.24 years

39098096.exclusion_reason: Development of a manual, visual semiquantitative myelination scoring system for pediatric MRI; not an AI/ML model itself (deep learning approaches are mentioned only as background/related work).

39112675.model_family: deep learning (accelerated Turbo Spin Echo reconstruction)
39112675.clinical_problem: Evaluating diagnostic performance and image quality of deep-learning-accelerated MRI in children and young adults with knee/ankle symptoms
39112675.patient_population: 48 subjects, 49 MRIs (10 males, mean age 16.4 years, range 7-29 years)
39112675.model_description: Deep-learning image reconstruction accelerates Turbo Spin Echo MRI sequences of the knee and ankle, evaluated for diagnostic accuracy and image quality against conventional sequences and, when available, arthroscopy.
39112675.headline_result: Sensitivity/specificity vs conventional: knees 90.7%/99.3%, ankles 100%/100%; DL sequences 2x faster acquisition

39125510.clinical_problem: Diagnosing pediatric thoracic diseases from chest X-rays using models pretrained on adult data (knowledge transfer), given limited pediatric training data
39125510.patient_population: Pediatric CXR dataset (PhysioNet); population not otherwise detailed
39125510.model_description: A three-stage self-supervised and transfer-learning framework fine-tunes transformer (ViT) and CNN models, pretrained on adult chest X-ray datasets (e.g., CheXpert), to diagnose and localize six pediatric thoracic disease categories on a small pediatric chest X-ray dataset.
39125510.release_evidence: The source code is available online and the data can be obtained from PhysioNet.
39125510.dataset_size: Pediatric CXR dataset (PhysioNet); size not stated
39125510.headline_result: ViT-Base/16 fine-tuned on CheXpert: mean AUC 0.761 (95%CI 0.759-0.763) across 6 disease categories, sensitivity 0.639, specificity 0.683
39125510.study_design: Retrospective model development and benchmarking study

39133952.model_name: ADU-GD (Attention Gate Double U-Net with Guided Decoder)
39133952.clinical_problem: Segmenting and measuring fetal biometric parameters (head circumference, abdominal circumference, femur length, biparietal diameter) from ultrasound
39133952.model_description: ADU-GD, an attention-gated double U-Net with a guided decoder, segments fetal anatomical structures on ultrasound and estimates biometric parameters (head circumference, abdominal circumference, femur length, biparietal diameter), benchmarked against numerous other deep-learning segmentation models.
39133952.headline_result: MAE 0.99 mm overall; Dice 99.1%; parameter MAE: HC 2.2mm, AC 2.6mm, FL 0.6mm, BPD 1.2mm
39133952.study_design: Retrospective model development and benchmarking study

39144940.model_family: k-nearest neighbor, SVM, random forest, XGBoost
39144940.body_region: fetal (prenatal screening, combined with biochemical markers)
39144940.clinical_problem: Screening for Down syndrome in the first and second trimesters using ultrasound and biochemical testing, especially in resource-limited settings
39144940.patient_population: 7,076 pregnant women in Northern Vietnam (1,035 with a fetus with Down syndrome)
39144940.model_description: Machine learning models (k-nearest neighbor, SVM, random forest, XGBoost) combine ultrasound findings and biochemical test results to predict Down syndrome risk in the first and second trimesters.
39144940.dataset_size: 7,076 pregnant women, single site in Northern Vietnam
39144940.headline_result: Trimester 1: XGBoost 94% accuracy, 88% AUC; Trimester 2: SVM 89% accuracy, 84% AUC

39186484.clinical_problem: Improving image quality of pediatric cardiac CT while managing radiation dose, comparing deep-learning reconstruction to conventional iterative reconstruction
39186484.model_description: Deep learning image reconstruction (TrueFidelity, at low/medium/high strength settings) is compared to adaptive statistical iterative reconstruction for quantitative (SNR, CNR, sharpness) and qualitative image quality on pediatric cardiac CT.
39186484.headline_result: High-level DLIR significantly improved SNR and CNR vs ASiR-V (P<0.05); improved sharpness (edge rise distance)

39256496.exclusion_reason: Animal (rat) model study of placental dysfunction in preeclampsia; not a human pediatric or fetal study.

39263285.model_family: CNN (DenseNet121 best of AlexNet, VGG16, Inception v3, ResNet50, DenseNet121)
39263285.clinical_problem: Diagnosing adenoid hypertrophy causing upper airway obstruction in children from lateral nasopharyngeal radiographs
39263285.patient_population: 1,188 children aged 8 months to 13 years (mean 5.57+/-2.66 years), three hospitals
39263285.model_description: Five deep learning models (AlexNet, VGG16, Inception v3, ResNet50, DenseNet121) are trained to diagnose adenoid hypertrophy from lateral nasopharyngeal radiographs; the best model (DenseNet121) is compared against three radiologists of varying seniority.
39263285.dataset_size: 1,188 children, three hospitals; 208 images in internal validation group
39263285.headline_result: DenseNet121 AUC 0.892 internal / 0.872 external; accuracy 0.895/0.878; comparable to senior radiologist (0.892 vs 0.901, p=0.79)
39263285.study_design: Retrospective multicenter model development with internal and external validation

39271408.body_region: cervix (maternal, for prenatal preterm-birth risk assessment)
39271408.clinical_problem: Automating region-of-interest selection for quantitative ultrasound analysis of the cervix to predict spontaneous preterm birth risk
39271408.model_description: A deep learning model automatically determines the field of interest for quantitative ultrasound (QUS) analysis of the cervix from B-mode ultrasound images, intended to replace time-consuming manual delineation for real-time preterm-birth risk assessment.
39271408.headline_result: Pixel accuracy 97%, Dice coefficient 87%; Pearson r=0.87 for attenuation coefficient vs manual field of interest

39284691.exclusion_reason: Study protocol for a cohort study relating preterm birth to neurodevelopment and cognition; no AI/ML model is described (planned analysis uses multivariable regressions and structural equation modeling).

39288819.exclusion_reason: Machine learning model predicting maternal surgical morbidity in placenta accreta spectrum; predominantly uses demographic and obstetric variables, with prenatal imaging findings only a minor input among 213 variables. Not a radiology-imaging-focused study.

39326551.exclusion_reason: Scoping review of critical-findings classification/communication standards in emergency radiology; the review's own inclusion criteria explicitly omit resources with an explicit pediatric focus or a predominant AI/NLP focus.

39385257.clinical_problem: Predicting cardiomyopathy risk in childhood cancer survivors from serial echocardiograms
39385257.patient_population: At-risk childhood cancer survivors >=1 year post initial cancer therapy, five centers; 542 pairs of echocardiogram montages (45 cases, 70 non-case survivors)
39385257.model_description: Deep convolutional neural networks trained on serial echocardiogram image montages, from multiple time points relative to cardiomyopathy diagnosis, predict which childhood cancer survivors are approaching or have developed cancer-therapy-related cardiomyopathy.
39385257.dataset_size: 542 pairs of echocardiogram montages (171 from 45 cases, 371 from 70 non-case survivors), five centers
39385257.headline_result: AUROC 0.89+/-0.02, AUPRC 0.83+/-0.03, F1 0.76+/-0.04 distinguishing case vs non-case montages
39385257.study_design: Retrospective multicenter model development study (10-fold cross-validation)

39395303.model_family: deep learning (dual dilated attention + multi-scale deformable transformer + graph convolution attention)
39395303.clinical_problem: Segmenting fetal brain tissue on MRI to support assessment of normal and congenital-disease-affected fetal neurodevelopment
39395303.patient_population: not stated (FeTA 2021 and FeTA 2022 public fetal brain MRI datasets)
39395303.model_description: MG-Net is a deep learning segmentation model, combining a dual dilated attention block, a multi-scale deformable transformer, and a graph convolution attention decoder, that automatically segments fetal brain tissue on MRI; code is released publicly.
39395303.release_evidence: The code is available at https://github.com/unicoco7/MG-Net/
39395303.headline_result: FeTA 2021: Dice 0.8666, IoU 0.7646, MAE 0.0027; FeTA 2022: Dice 0.8552, IoU 0.7470, MAE 0.0005; outperformed nnFormer, SwinUNETR, 3DUX-net
39395303.study_design: Retrospective model development and benchmarking study on public datasets

39396080.exclusion_reason: Animal (mouse) study of blood-biomarker-based radiation biodosimetry; not human, and not an imaging study (uses blood cell/protein biomarkers via flow cytometry, not radiology images).

39432664.exclusion_reason: Review of prediction models for endometriosis-associated ovarian carcinoma in adult women; not pediatric, and predictors are largely serological/clinical rather than radiology-image-based.

39433994.exclusion_reason: Logistic regression model predicting preterm birth from maternal socio-demographic and obstetric history; explicitly avoids using imaging (cervical length ultrasound) as an input.

39447089.exclusion_reason: Machine learning model predicting pediatric Hodgkin lymphoma treatment response from blood test results, not imaging; PET-CT findings are the prediction target/reference rather than a model input.

39509989.exclusion_reason: Standard fMRI functional connectivity analysis comparing adolescents with autism spectrum disorder to typically developing peers during a language task; no AI/machine-learning model is used.

39539491.exclusion_reason: Pilot fMRI study of neurofeedback-augmented mindfulness training in typically developing adolescents; uses standard statistical (linear mixed effects) analysis, not an AI/machine-learning model.

39546640.clinical_problem: Suppressing bone structures on pediatric chest radiographs to reduce missed pneumonia diagnoses caused by bone occlusion
39546640.patient_population: Customized pediatric CXR dataset (P260): 40 labeled images for fine-tuning, 220 unlabeled images for testing; network pretrained on 240 adult CXR images
39546640.model_description: A deep learning bone-suppression network, pretrained on adult chest radiographs and fine-tuned via an efficient automated labeling pipeline (distance-transform-based bone-edge detection plus traditional image processing), generates separate bone and soft-tissue images from pediatric chest radiographs without specialized dual-energy equipment.
39546640.dataset_size: 240 adult CXR (pretraining); 40 labeled + 220 unlabeled pediatric CXR (P260 dataset)
39546640.headline_result: Bone-suppression network: relative MAE 3.38%, PSNR 35.5 dB, SSIM 98.1%, bone-suppression ratio 90.1%

39568996.exclusion_reason: Transformer-based deep learning model predicting acute hematogenous osteomyelitis and blood culture results from laboratory indicators; radiology is mentioned only as background context, not used as a model input.

39616218.clinical_problem: Predicting subcortical (thalamic) functional connectivity from cortical fNIRS signals for potential bedside brain monitoring, including in neonates with early brain injury
39616218.patient_population: Healthy adults and neonates with early brain injuries (two separate datasets)
39616218.model_description: A graph convolutional network predicts cortical-thalamic functional connectivity, as measured by fMRI, from cortical functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) data, evaluated in healthy adults and separately in neonates with early brain injury, as a step toward using fNIRS for bedside brain monitoring of critically ill patients.
39616218.dataset_size: Two datasets: healthy adults and neonates with early brain injury (sample sizes not stated in abstract)
39616218.headline_result: GCN outperformed SVM and feedforward artificial neural networks for both binary connection classification and connection-strength regression
39616218.study_design: Retrospective model development and benchmarking study

39673623.clinical_problem: Predicting postoperative brain development / neurocognitive outcome in children treated for hydrocephalus, using brain and ventricular volumes and MRI texture
39673623.patient_population: 52 children under age 10 undergoing hydrocephalus treatment
39673623.model_description: Three deep-learning classification models use texture information from pre- and postoperative T1-weighted brain MRI to predict brain development outcomes in children treated for hydrocephalus, compared using four-fold cross-validation.
39673623.headline_result: Accuracy 0.808 for postoperative-image-based prediction of brain development
39673623.study_design: Retrospective cohort study with deep learning prediction models

39685997.clinical_problem: Generating synthetic CT from cone-beam CT for adaptive proton and carbon-ion radiotherapy planning in pediatric oncology patients
39685997.model_description: An unsupervised CycleGAN-based model generates synthetic CT images from cone-beam CT scans of pediatric pelvic patients, intended to support image-guided adaptive proton and carbon-ion particle therapy without an additional planning CT.
39685997.dataset_size: 15 young pelvic patients, 44 CBCT scans (36 training, 8 testing volumes)
39685997.headline_result: Improved SSIM and PSNR of synthetic CT vs verification CT compared to raw registered CBCT (quantitative and qualitative improvement)

39689732.clinical_problem: Characterizing white matter (diffusion MRI) abnormalities in pediatric bipolar disorder, including whether machine learning classifiers can differentiate patients from healthy controls
39689732.patient_population: 23 included studies of children/adolescents with pediatric bipolar disorder vs. healthy controls
39689732.model_description: Systematic review of 23 diffusion MRI studies in pediatric bipolar disorder, synthesizing white matter tract abnormalities (fractional anisotropy, diffusivity, structural connectivity) and noting that machine learning classifiers built on these diffusion MRI features showed promising ability to differentiate pediatric bipolar disorder from healthy controls.

39700855.clinical_problem: Generating synthetic 3D brain tumor MRI regions to address class imbalance in tumor genetic-marker/type classification, including pediatric low-grade glioma BRAF V600E mutation status
39700855.patient_population: BraTS 2019 low-grade glioma cases (public, largely adult) and an internal pediatric low-grade glioma (pLGG) dataset
39700855.model_description: A vector-quantization GAN combined with a transformer (masked token modeling) generates high-resolution, diverse synthetic 3D brain tumor regions of interest on MRI, used to augment imbalanced training data for tumor-type/genetic-marker classification, including BRAF V600E mutation status in pediatric low-grade glioma.
39700855.dataset_size: BraTS 2019 low-grade glioma cases (public); internal pediatric low-grade glioma dataset

42005095.exclusion_reason: systematic review of AutoML in dentistry/oral healthcare; dental imaging is out of scope

42034914.clinical_problem: Support diagnosis, risk stratification, and medical-versus-surgical decision-making for necrotizing enterocolitis in neonates, including automated radiographic diagnosis
42034914.model_description: A commentary reviewing how machine learning models integrate multimodal clinical and radiographic data to automate NEC radiographic diagnosis, stratify risk, distinguish medical from surgical phenotypes, and support intervention decisions in the NICU.

42047765.clinical_problem: Summarize AI applications across the pediatric oncology imaging pipeline: image acquisition/quality, tumor segmentation, lesion detection/classification, staging, prognosis, and report generation
42047765.model_description: A review summarizing deep learning and radiomics applications across the pediatric oncology imaging pipeline, from motion correction and multicenter harmonization to tumor segmentation, lesion detection, staging/prognosis, and LLM-based report generation.

42062550.exclusion_reason: general (not pediatric-specific) method for accelerated diffusion MRI parameter estimation; pediatric applications mentioned only as a potential future benefit, not studied

42203630.clinical_problem: Measure temporalis muscle thickness on brain MRI as a biomarker to track sarcopenia and predict morbidity/mortality in pediatric brain tumor patients
42203630.patient_population: 881 individuals with pediatric brain tumor (5,661 MRIs) from one prospective trial and two retrospective databases; 730 patients with linked iTMT and weight data, mean age 13.4 years
42203630.model_description: Applies an AI-based automated measurement tool to brain MRI to derive temporalis muscle thickness (iTMT) longitudinally, generating percentile curves used to detect sarcopenia and sarcopenic overweight and associate them with physical functioning, endocrine outcomes, and survival.
42203630.dataset_size: 5,661 MRIs from 881 individuals (730 with linked weight data)
42203630.headline_result: 73% developed iTMT sarcopenia, 29% sarcopenic overweight; sarcopenia at diagnosis associated with worse survival in high-grade glioma (log-rank p=0.046)
42203630.study_design: retrospective secondary analysis of three cohorts (one prospective trial, two retrospective databases)

42233989.clinical_problem: Synthesize AI applications across pediatric chest radiography, lung ultrasound, CT and MRI, focused on LMIC deployment for pneumonia and cardiopulmonary disease diagnosis
42233989.patient_population: pediatric chest imaging patients (narrative review with illustrative real-world cases, including LMIC settings)
42233989.model_description: A narrative/pictorial review of AI across pediatric chest radiography, lung ultrasound, CT and MRI, including a real-world evaluation of the CAD4Kids tool and the general-purpose vision-language model MedGemma on adult and pediatric chest radiographs, which showed critical failures such as missed pericardial effusion and tuberculosis.
42233989.study_design: narrative/pictorial review with illustrative real-world case evaluation of MedGemma

42257728.clinical_problem: Diagnose pediatric appendicitis from abdominal ultrasound images, report text, and clinical data using a zero-shot general-purpose vision-language model
42257728.patient_population: 294 patients from the Regensburg Pediatric Appendicitis Dataset
42257728.model_description: Takes combinations of pediatric abdominal ultrasound images, structured ultrasound report text, and clinical data as zero-shot prompts to a general-purpose vision-language model (Llama 4 Maverick) and outputs a binary appendicitis diagnosis.
42257728.dataset_size: 294 patients (from up to 782 screened) from the Regensburg Pediatric Appendicitis Dataset
42257728.headline_result: Images-only: AUROC 0.567, specificity 13.5%; ultrasound report text: AUROC 0.883, specificity 63.5%; combining images with text gave no further improvement
42257728.study_design: retrospective diagnostic accuracy study using a public dataset

42274787.clinical_problem: Summarize current and emerging AI applications across the pediatric interventional radiology pathway (pre-procedural planning, intra-procedural guidance, post-procedural follow-up)
42274787.model_description: A review outlining current and emerging AI applications across the pediatric interventional radiology pathway, including pre-procedural planning, intra-procedural guidance, and post-procedural follow-up, and the technical, ethical and regulatory considerations unique to children.

42321373.clinical_problem: Provide a general-purpose foundation model representation of fetal ultrasound images to support downstream tasks such as classification, gestational age estimation, congenital heart defect detection, and structure segmentation
42321373.patient_population: fetal ultrasound images (210,035 images paired with text, the largest such dataset for VLM development to date)
42321373.model_description: A CLIP-style vision-language foundation model pre-trained on 210,035 fetal ultrasound image-text pairs, producing general-purpose representations usable for downstream classification, gestational age estimation, congenital heart defect detection, and fetal structure segmentation with limited labeled data.
42321373.release_evidence: The FetalCLIP model is publicly available at https://github.com/biomedia-mbzuai/fetalclip
42321373.dataset_size: 210,035 fetal ultrasound images paired with text
42321373.headline_result: Outperformed all baselines across classification, gestational age estimation, CHD detection, and structure segmentation benchmarks
42321373.study_design: retrospective foundation model development and benchmarking study

42386757.model_family: deep learning segmentation / diffeomorphic registration atlas
42386757.clinical_problem: Provide a reference spatiotemporal atlas and automated segmentation tool for characterizing typical fetal brain development from 21-37 gestational weeks
42386757.patient_population: 159 fetuses with typically developing brains, 21-37 gestational weeks
42386757.model_description: A diffeomorphic deformable registration framework with kernel regression on gestational age builds a 4D fetal brain MRI atlas with tissue segmentations and 126-region parcellation; FetalSEG is a companion deep-learning multiclass segmentation tool for automatic fetal brain MRI segmentation.
42386757.release_evidence: We release de-identified, processed subject-level fetal MRI datasets... We also provide FetalSEG, a deep learning-based multiclass segmentation tool
42386757.study_design: retrospective atlas construction and tool development study

42489880.clinical_problem: Address barriers to global validation and implementation of AI in pediatric radiology (data inequality/bias, infrastructure, regulatory/ethical gaps, workforce, language, cost, sustainability) and propose an equity-focused roadmap
42489880.model_description: A World Federation of Pediatric Imaging position paper outlining barriers to equitable global implementation of AI in pediatric radiology and a time-sequenced roadmap to address them.

39401118.body_region: fetal (multiple anatomical structures, incl. four-chamber cardiac view)
39401118.clinical_problem: Detect fetal anatomical structures on ultrasound images, including rare/hard-to-sample structures, to support structural evaluation
39401118.model_description: Takes fetal ultrasound images and, via a Topological Knowledge Reasoning Module and a Discriminate Ability Enhanced Feature Learning Module, performs few-shot object detection of fetal anatomical structures using only a small number of labeled examples per category.
39401118.headline_result: Outperformed state-of-the-art baselines by up to 4.8% on 5-shot detection of the four-chamber cardiac view (split 1)
39401118.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and benchmarking study

39810112.exclusion_reason: dental radiography (panoramic radiograph tooth agenesis classification); dental imaging is out of scope

39817730.exclusion_reason: predicts small-for-gestational-age from clinical/biometric measurements (nuchal thickness, EFW, maternal age) rather than from ultrasound image analysis; not an imaging-AI model

39827255.exclusion_reason: predicts neurocognitive outcome in preterm infants using clinical/antenatal variables, not imaging data; explicitly avoids MRI-derived predictors

39838221.model_family: transformer (Swin Transformer with spatial/channel reconstruction convolution block)
39838221.clinical_problem: Automatically grade skeletal maturity (Risser stage) from pelvis radiographs to guide adolescent idiopathic scoliosis evaluation and treatment
39838221.patient_population: children/adolescents with adolescent idiopathic scoliosis undergoing pelvis radiography
39838221.model_description: Extracts the iliac region from pelvis radiographs via a multi-task learning approach and classifies Risser stage using an improved Swin Transformer with a spatial and channel reconstruction convolutional block, with Grad-CAM visualization for interpretability.
39838221.headline_result: Risser stage assessment accuracy 81.53%, outperforming ResNet50/101, Uniformer, Next-ViT, ConvNeXt, and original Swin Transformer by 1.8-5.85 percentage points

39863639.exclusion_reason: general-purpose multi-organ ultrasound anomaly dataset (organs, vessels, musculoskeletal, fetal) not focused on a pediatric or fetal population specifically

39869146.exclusion_reason: predicts surgical necessity for pediatric hydronephrosis using clinical and imaging-derived numeric variables (kidney size, scintigraphy result) rather than direct AI analysis of images

39869281.clinical_problem: Generate accurate virtual 3D reconstructions of complex congenital heart anatomy from 3D rotational angiography for procedural planning
39869281.patient_population: 5 pediatric patients undergoing 3D rotational angiography in a pediatric cardiac catheterization suite
39869281.model_description: Takes 3D rotational angiography DICOM images of congenital heart anatomy and, via the Axial3D cloud-based AI platform, automatically segments and reconstructs a detailed virtual 3D model including color-coded implanted materials, compared against manual operator reconstructions.
39869281.release_evidence: Axial3D Artificial Intelligence (AI) driven cloud-based platform
39869281.headline_result: Axial3D produced highly detailed reconstructions with superior segmentation of intrathoracic structures compared to local expert reconstructions (qualitative assessment, no single number given)
39869281.study_design: retrospective feasibility study with reader comparison (n=5)

39883136.exclusion_reason: radiomics model for placenta accreta spectrum, a maternal/placental disorder in adult patients; not a fetal or pediatric diagnosis

39890863.exclusion_reason: provider survey of obstetric ultrasound use and priorities for future AI development in LMICs; no AI model or diagnostic performance evaluated

39910276.clinical_problem: Diagnose neonatal respiratory distress syndrome from chest radiographs using radiomics, examining the effect of rib suppression
39910276.model_description: Applies rib suppression preprocessing to neonatal chest radiographs, extracts radiomic features from lung regions before and after suppression, and trains machine learning classifiers (e.g., Gradient Boosting Machine) to diagnose neonatal respiratory distress syndrome.
39910276.headline_result: GBM AUC 0.781 post-rib-suppression vs 0.556 pre-suppression; combined-feature LDA AUC 0.762, LR AUC 0.756
39910276.study_design: retrospective single-cohort radiomics model development study

39938055.exclusion_reason: diagnoses pediatric community-acquired pneumonia using urine metabolomics (random forest on metabolite concentrations); laboratory-only, not an imaging study

39941918.exclusion_reason: metabolomic/liquid biopsy biomarker study for soft tissue sarcoma; laboratory-only, no imaging AI component

39943270.clinical_problem: Automatically measure the frontomaxillary facial angle on prenatal ultrasound for trisomy 21 screening
39943270.model_description: Trains a deep learning network to segment critical facial regions on 2D fetal ultrasound images, then uses a keypoint detection network to locate landmark points and compute the frontomaxillary facial angle automatically.
39943270.headline_result: Mean absolute error 2.354 degrees, outperforming typical junior-expert accuracy standards

39945559.clinical_problem: Investigate correlation between Lhermitte's sign and AI-based radiological characteristics (upper cervical spinal cord lesions) in pediatric-onset multiple sclerosis
39945559.patient_population: 92 patients with pediatric-onset multiple sclerosis (from 1,298 records screened)
39945559.model_description: Uses AI-based radiological analysis of spinal cord MRI to characterize cervical lesions (C1-4) and correlate them with the clinical sign Lhermitte's sign in pediatric-onset MS patients.
39945559.headline_result: Upper cervical lesion (C1-4) frequency higher in groups with current/past Lhermitte's sign vs never (p=0.017)

39947483.clinical_problem: Automate segmentation of cardiac MRI to study right ventricular remodeling and identify imaging traits associated with adverse RV remodeling in repaired tetralogy of Fallot
39947483.patient_population: 758 patients with repaired tetralogy of Fallot at Children's Hospital of Philadelphia; 152 with 2 analyzable CMR scans
39947483.model_description: Uses the nnU-Net deep learning method to automatically segment left and right ventricular blood pool and myocardium from 2D short-axis cardiac MRI, then computes volumetric remodeling rates to study risk factors for right ventricular deterioration after tetralogy of Fallot repair.
39947483.headline_result: Pulmonic valve replacement patients had significantly lower RV remodeling rates than natural-history patients; baseline LV measures associated with RV remodeling rates

39984475.body_region: brain (pineal/suprasellar region, intracranial germ cell tumor)
39984475.clinical_problem: Provide a public imaging dataset to support development of AI models to improve diagnostic accuracy for germinoma, avoiding unnecessary surgery
39984475.patient_population: 65 pathologically confirmed germinoma patients (adolescents, peak incidence age group; also children)
39984475.model_description: Releases a public multimodal imaging dataset (T2, FLAIR, T1, contrast-enhanced T1, DWI MRI, and CT) with clinical and radiomic features from 65 pathologically confirmed germinoma cases to support training and validation of future AI diagnostic models.
39984475.release_evidence: there are no publicly available imaging datasets for germinoma. This study aimed to create a comprehensive dataset for germinoma...

40000329.clinical_problem: Improve image quality and diagnostic visualization of temporal bone structures on ultra-high-resolution CT using deep learning reconstruction, including in a pediatric-dose protocol
40000329.patient_population: 35 patients (57 temporal bones): 30 in the adult protocol subgroup, 5 children in the pediatric protocol subgroup
40000329.model_description: Applies a vendor-specific deep learning reconstruction algorithm (AiCE Inner Ear) to ultra-high-resolution temporal bone CT raw data, producing denoised images with improved contrast-to-noise and signal-to-noise ratios compared to hybrid iterative reconstruction, evaluated in both adult- and pediatric-dose protocols.
40000329.release_evidence: a novel, vendor-specific deep learning-based reconstruction (DLR) algorithm called AiCE Inner Ear
40000329.dataset_size: 57 temporal bones from 35 patients (30 adult protocol, 5 pediatric protocol)
40000329.headline_result: DLR significantly improved subjective image quality (p<0.024), reduced noise (p<0.001), increased CNR/SNR (p<0.001) in both adult and pediatric protocol subgroups

40030964.exclusion_reason: detects adenoid hypertrophy from heart-lung sound recordings using deep learning; non-imaging (acoustic) data, not a radiology study

40049153.clinical_problem: Classify neonatal respiratory diseases (RDS, TTN, air leak syndrome, atelectasis, BPD) versus healthy lungs on portable chest radiographs in the NICU
40049153.patient_population: 43,338 portable chest radiographs from newborns at 10 university hospitals in Korea (34,598 training, 4,370 validation, 4,370 testing)
40049153.model_description: Takes portable supine neonatal chest radiographs (plus gestational age and birth weight) and, via a modified ResNet50 deep-learning model, classifies the image into one of six categories: healthy lung, RDS, TTN, air leak syndrome, atelectasis, or bronchopulmonary dysplasia.
40049153.headline_result: Overall test accuracy 83.96%, F1 83.68% (per-condition F1: BPD 92.19%, ALS 90.65%, RDS 90.30%, atelectasis 86.56%, healthy 87.38%, TTN 70.84%)
40049153.study_design: retrospective multicenter deep learning model development study

40058414.exclusion_reason: machine learning model predicts pediatric CVID from EMR utilization counts (e.g., number of chest radiographs ordered, antibiotic prescriptions); uses EMR metadata, not image analysis

40080439.exclusion_reason: general review of multiparametric MR urography technique across all patient populations; pediatric patients mentioned only as one special-population indication, and AI/deep learning reconstruction is a minor passing mention, not the review's focus

40129724.clinical_problem: Automatically quantify lesion-free brain volumes in children with unilateral cerebral palsy to relate brain structure to motor and visual outcomes
40129724.patient_population: 35 patients (ages 5-15) for training; validated on 54 children with CP (ages 7-16) and an independent set of 36 children with congenital/acquired brain anatomy distortions (ages 1-17)
40129724.model_description: Trains deep learning models on T1-weighted and FLAIR MRI, using an automatic label generation workflow, to segment brain structures and lesions and compute lesion-free brain and regional volumes, correlated with lesion extent and motor/visual outcomes.
40129724.dataset_size: 35 training patients; 54 validation children with CP; independent set of 36 children with brain anatomy distortions
40129724.headline_result: Reduced affected-hemisphere volumes correlated with lesion extent (p<0.05); regional (e.g., thalamic) lesion-free volumes linked to motor/visual outcomes (p<0.05)
40129724.study_design: retrospective algorithm development with independent external validation cohort

40137200.clinical_problem: Recover image quality in low-dose pediatric renal scintigraphy to allow reduced radiation exposure
40137200.model_description: Applies denoising neural networks (DnCNN, UDnCNN, DUDnCNN, AttnGAN) to simulated half-dose (50% counts) pediatric renal scintigraphy images to restore image quality comparable to full-dose acquisitions.
40137200.headline_result: UDnCNN achieved the best balance of SNR and MS-SSIM among four networks; half-dose reconstructed images comparable to full-dose
40137200.study_design: retrospective algorithm development study using a public dataset

40146686.clinical_problem: Automatically evaluate the scan quality of pelvic ultrasound images used to diagnose developmental dysplasia of the hip by scoring five anatomical landmarks
40146686.patient_population: 1,891 subjects (infants) from two hospitals in Korea
40146686.model_description: Uses an ensemble of transfer-learning CNN models to score the quality/visibility of five anatomical landmarks on pelvic ultrasound images for DDH screening, with Grad-CAM verification and an accelerated sequence method for real-time use.
40146686.headline_result: Kappa >=0.6 for all models; AUC 0.89 for classifying standard images; processing time 0.20-0.35 s/image

40153835.clinical_problem: Assess whether AI-generated craniometric analysis changes healthcare resource utilization (radiography ordering, physical therapy, orthotic therapy, specialist follow-up) in neonates evaluated for head shape deformities
40153835.patient_population: 1,000 pediatric patients referred for head shape concerns (2019-2023); 663 conventional, 337 AI-assisted encounters, propensity matched
40153835.model_description: An AI tool generates craniometric measurements and interpretations for neonatal head shape (e.g., distinguishing craniosynostosis from benign deformities), reviewed by providers during clinical encounters; this study compares downstream healthcare resource utilization between AI-reviewed and conventional encounters.
40153835.headline_result: AI review associated with increased orthotic therapy use (31.5% vs 38.6%, p=0.0132); no significant change in radiology ordering rates; all AI craniosynostosis-vs-benign diagnoses congruent with final diagnosis
40153835.study_design: retrospective propensity-matched cohort study of clinical workflow

40158938.clinical_problem: Classify adolescents with major depressive disorder from healthy adolescents using whole-brain resting-state functional connectivity as a potential imaging biomarker
40158938.patient_population: 94 adolescents with MDD and 78 healthy adolescent controls
40158938.model_description: Uses resting-state fMRI functional connectivity between 90 brain regions of interest as input features to a linear support vector machine classifier, which outputs a diagnostic classification of adolescent MDD versus healthy control.
40158938.dataset_size: 94 adolescents with MDD, 78 healthy adolescent controls

40175204.clinical_problem: Generate synthetic T2*-weighted gradient echo knee MRI images (useful for cartilage, synovial blooming, chondrocalcinosis, and pediatric physis assessment) from routinely acquired fat-suppressed intermediate-weighted images, avoiding an extra sequence
40175204.patient_population: 12,118 training and 2,996 test sagittal knee MR images from children, adolescents, and adults
40175204.model_description: A CycleGAN model trained on fat-suppressed intermediate-weighted knee MRI images generates synthetic T2*-weighted gradient echo images without requiring an additional acquisition, evaluated for diagnostic interchangeability and image quality.
40175204.release_evidence: Code, model and a standalone executable file are provided on github.
40175204.headline_result: Median NRMSE 0.5, PSNR 17.4, SSIM 0.5; ICC >0.95 for diagnostic interchangeability across findings
40175204.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and validation study

40178663.clinical_problem: Investigate how childhood maltreatment affects neurovascular coupling in adolescent depression and use these imaging features to classify MDD
40178663.patient_population: 189 adolescents: 54 MDD with childhood maltreatment, 45 MDD without, 33 healthy controls with maltreatment, 57 healthy controls without
40178663.model_description: Uses multimodal MRI-derived cerebral blood flow, functional connectivity strength, and amplitude of low-frequency fluctuation measures (integrated as neurovascular coupling ratios) as input features to a support vector machine classifier distinguishing adolescents with MDD.
40178663.headline_result: Integration of NVC ratio, CBF, and neuronal activity yielded robust classification performance distinguishing MDD adolescents (no single AUC/accuracy number given)

40180124.clinical_problem: Automate real-time planning of phase-contrast flow imaging sequences for fetal cardiovascular MRI to widen access to fetal flow imaging
40180124.patient_population: 167 and 71 fetal datasets for training two networks; evaluated retrospectively in 10 datasets and prospectively in 7 fetal subjects (36-39 weeks gestation)
40180124.model_description: Two deep learning networks localize the fetal body and detect cardiac landmarks (descending aorta, spine, umbilical vein) on a coronal whole-uterus MRI scan to automatically plan 2D phase-contrast flow imaging in real time, compared against manual planning.
40180124.dataset_size: 167 + 71 fetal training datasets; 10 retrospective + 7 prospective evaluation cases
40180124.headline_result: Fetal body localization Dice 0.94+-0.05; cardiac landmark errors 4.3-5.8mm; indexed flow measurements differed by -1.8% (range -14.2% to 14.9%) vs manual planning; successful in 6/7 prospective cases
40180124.study_design: retrospective algorithm development with prospective feasibility evaluation

40193010.clinical_problem: Improve image quality of pediatric and neonatal chest and abdominal radiographs via AI-based noise reduction to compensate for image degradation
40193010.patient_population: 46 consecutive pediatric and neonatal chest/abdomen radiograph cases
40193010.model_description: Applies Canon's Intelligent NR AI-based noise reduction algorithm to pediatric and neonatal chest/abdominal radiographs, compared against conventional noise reduction and scored by three radiologists using a 4-point visual grading scale.
40193010.release_evidence: AI-based noise reduction processing (Intelligent NR, Canon Inc.)
40193010.headline_result: Significantly higher image quality scores with AI-based noise reduction vs conventional (p<0.05)

40198622.exclusion_reason: dental radiography (bitewing) for pulp involvement in primary molars; dental imaging is out of scope

40216614.exclusion_reason: differentiates idiopathic short stature from growth hormone deficiency using stepwise logistic regression on pituitary MRI measurements and biochemical markers; conventional statistics, no AI/ML component

40216875.exclusion_reason: resting-state fMRI group-comparison study of thalamocortical connectivity in perinatal stroke using standard statistical methods (ALFF, ReHo, connectivity metrics); no AI/ML classification or prediction model

40221729.exclusion_reason: predicts treatment response in infantile epileptic spasms syndrome from clinical/demographic variables (age of onset, treatment choice) with MRI subtype as one categorical covariate; not an imaging AI model

40231580.exclusion_reason: validates clinical decision rules (TWIST, TT score, BALS, AIS, new TEST score) based on history and physical exam findings for testicular torsion; explicitly aims to avoid ultrasound imaging, not an imaging AI study

40289637.body_region: brain (anterior cingulate, middle frontal gyrus, orbitofrontal cortex)
40289637.clinical_problem: Determine whether autistic characteristics and frontal-region brain morphology predict future social anhedonia and alexithymia in adolescents with acute or weight-restored anorexia nervosa
40289637.patient_population: 183 individuals (67 healthy controls, 68 acute anorexia nervosa, 48 weight-restored) from the BEACON study; adolescents (some young adults)
40289637.model_description: Uses structural MRI-derived volume and surface area of the anterior cingulate cortex, middle frontal gyrus, and orbitofrontal cortex, together with autistic-characteristic scores, as input to random forest regression models predicting future levels of social anhedonia and alexithymia.
40289637.headline_result: RFR models showed moderate-to-weak predictive performance; autistic characteristics were not important predictive features
40289637.study_design: retrospective case-control neuroimaging study with random forest regression

40296263.exclusion_reason: evaluates ChatGPT diagnostic and treatment decision accuracy in pediatric dentistry; dental imaging/care is out of scope

40297347.clinical_problem: Synthesize MRI radiomics approaches for diagnosis and prognosis of childhood brain tumors, focusing on ependymoma and medulloblastoma
40297347.patient_population: 19 included studies (pediatric brain tumor patients, from 559 screened)
40297347.model_description: A systematic review of 19 MRI radiomics studies in childhood brain tumors (mainly ependymoma and medulloblastoma), summarizing preprocessing, segmentation, feature extraction (GLCM, GLRLM), feature selection (LASSO, PCA) and classification (most commonly SVM) approaches and their diagnostic/prognostic performance.
40297347.headline_result: SVM most common classifier (9/19 studies), AUC range 0.858-0.977

40299004.clinical_problem: Compare accuracy of AI-supported antenatal fetal weight estimation with that of sonographers of different experience levels near term
40299004.patient_population: 300 fetuses at mean gestational age 38.7+-1.1 weeks scheduled for elective cesarean section
40299004.model_description: An AI-supported algorithm performs automated antenatal fetal weight estimation using the Hadlock formula 3 from ultrasound measurements, compared prospectively against a junior and a senior sonographer's manual estimates relative to actual birth weight.
40299004.headline_result: AI accurate in 48.3% of cases vs 62% (junior) and 70% (senior) sonographer; AI mean difference from birth weight -338.4+-606.2g (largest error of the three)

40313303.clinical_problem: Predict brain age and regional brain structure age gaps from MRI to serve as a neuroimaging biomarker of disease severity/progression in GM1 gangliosidosis
40313303.patient_population: 81 MRI scans from 41 Type II GM1 gangliosidosis patients (juvenile and late-infantile subtypes) and 897 MRI scans from 556 neurotypical controls
40313303.model_description: Applies a machine learning MRI analysis pipeline (BrainStructuresAges) to compute predicted brain age and regional Brain Structures Age Gap Estimation from structural MRI, showing accelerated brain aging rates in GM1 gangliosidosis patients that correlate with clinical severity, intended as a surrogate outcome measure for clinical trials.
40313303.dataset_size: 81 MRI scans from 41 GM1 patients; 897 MRI scans from 556 neurotypical controls
40313303.headline_result: Whole-brain aging rate: 0.83/year (controls) vs 1.57/year (juvenile GM1) vs 12.25/year (late-infantile GM1); predicted brain age and BSAGE correlated with clinical assessments
40313303.study_design: retrospective cross-sectional/longitudinal neuroimaging biomarker study (medRxiv preprint)

40314875.model_family: deep learning (TW3 bone age scoring) + quantitative synthetic MRI
40314875.clinical_problem: Determine whether brain tissue composition biomarkers from synthetic MRI relate more strongly to bone age development than reproductive hormones in central precocious puberty
40314875.patient_population: 84 children with central precocious puberty and 84 controls
40314875.model_description: Uses quantitative synthetic MRI (SyMRI) to derive brain tissue component volumes (myelin, white matter, gray matter, CSF) and a deep learning model to score Tanner-Whitehouse III bone age from hand-wrist X-rays, then correlates these with hormone levels in children with central precocious puberty.
40314875.headline_result: TW3-Carpal score positively correlated with myelin content (r=0.397, P<0.001); not correlated with hormone levels

40323639.model_family: gradient boosting / deep learning (3D ResNet-18 features + radiomics)
40323639.clinical_problem: Predict 3-year postoperative disease-free survival in pediatric malignant brain tumor patients by combining MRI radiomics, deep learning features, and clinical indices
40323639.patient_population: 260 pediatric patients with brain tumors who underwent R0 resection, age <=14 years
40323639.model_description: Extracts 1,130 radiomics features (Pyradiomics) and 511 deep learning features (3D ResNet-18) from preoperative T1-enhanced MRI with manually delineated tumors, combines them with clinical indices via Lasso feature reduction, and trains machine learning models (SVM, random forest, LightGBM) to predict 3-year disease-free survival.
40323639.headline_result: Fusion model (LightGBM): AUC 0.859, accuracy 85.2%; combined with clinical indexes AUC improved to 0.909
40323639.study_design: retrospective multimodal ML model development study

40327070.clinical_problem: Automatically measure the Cobb angle from full-spine radiographs to assess scoliosis severity, replacing time-consuming manual measurement with variability
40327070.patient_population: children and adolescents undergoing full-spine DR for scoliosis (1,163 AP and 1,378 LAT view images)
40327070.model_description: A deep learning framework (YOLOv8 with CBAM) classifies AP/LAT spine views, locates the region of interest, detects vertebral boundaries, types, and corner points, and automatically computes the Cobb angle from full-spine digital radiographs.
40327070.dataset_size: 1,163 AP view and 1,378 LAT view DR images
40327070.headline_result: Mean Cobb angle error 2.56 deg (AP), 2.50 deg (LAT); ICC 0.956 (AP), 0.925 (LAT); reader study major curve error 3.92 deg, ICC 0.943
40327070.study_design: retrospective algorithm development with reader study validation

40327352.exclusion_reason: review of precision medicine for pediatric ventilation/respiratory management; imaging (lung ultrasound) is only one of several non-imaging technologies discussed (EIT, NAVA, ventilator monitoring ML), not the focus

40353268.exclusion_reason: general editorial on AI across obstetrics and gynaecology (fertility, cancer treatment, CTG, imaging); not focused on pediatric or fetal radiology AI specifically

40354198.clinical_problem: Support differential diagnosis, treatment planning, and generation of medical records/radiology reports for pediatric pneumonia
40354198.patient_population: 163,999 outpatient and 8,684 inpatient pediatric cases; test set of 642 samples verified by pediatric pulmonology specialists
40354198.model_description: A medical multimodal large language model trained on a three-stage strategy using plain-text clinical records and interleaved image-text pairs (2D chest X-ray, 3D chest CT, and radiology reports) to generate free-text medical records and radiology reports and support clinical decision-making for pediatric pneumonia.
40354198.dataset_size: 163,999 outpatient and 8,684 inpatient cases (training); 642-sample test set
40354198.headline_result: Automated LLM scoring corroborated by manual specialist scoring on 642-sample test set demonstrating superiority of P2Med-MLLM (no single numeric headline given)
40354198.study_design: retrospective large-scale multimodal model development and evaluation study

40356794.model_family: automated bone age software (image analysis algorithm)
40356794.clinical_problem: Compare automated (BoneXpert) versus manual (Greulich-Pyle) bone age assessment methods in children with pediatric endocrinology diagnoses
40356794.patient_population: 260 left hand-wrist radiographs of South African children with various pediatric endocrinology diagnoses
40356794.model_description: BoneXpert automatically analyzes hand-wrist radiographs to compute a composite (carpal + tubular bone) bone age score, compared against the manual Greulich-Pyle method performed by three independent readers.
40356794.release_evidence: BoneXpert software performed automated bone age assessment
40356794.headline_result: ICC between Manual BA and BoneXpert BA = 0.982; best-fit composite weighting: 50% carpal, 50% tubular bones

40373660.clinical_problem: Automatically estimate segmentation quality and detect segmentation errors in fetal MRI structures to support clinical QC and model development

41359722.clinical_problem: automated Cobb angle measurement and vertebral wedging assessment for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis severity
41359722.patient_population: patients aged 10-18 years with full-spine anteroposterior radiographs for scoliosis
41359722.model_description: The model takes full-spine anteroposterior radiographs and predicts superior and inferior endplate angles and vertebral midpoints for each vertebra, combining an HRNet/Swin-Transformer backbone with singular value decomposition to compute Cobb angle and a new Vertebral Wedging Index without assuming a predefined curve pattern.
41359722.dataset_size: 630 full-spine radiographs from patients aged 10-18 years

41359722.study_design: retrospective model development with dual-rater annotation

41367603.exclusion_reason: narrative review of pediatric GI endoscopy; non-radiologic imaging (endoscopy), AI mentioned only as a brief future direction

41395634.model_family: U-Net++ segmentation plus binary CNN classifier (2-step deep learning pipeline)
41395634.clinical_problem: detecting Monteggia fracture dislocations (radial head dislocation with ulnar fracture) on pediatric elbow radiographs
41395634.patient_population: pediatric patients with elbow radiographs used to train/test the pipeline (320 for segmentation, 157 for classification)
41395634.model_description: A two-step deep learning pipeline: a U-Net++ network segments the capitellum and radial neck on AP and lateral elbow radiographs to algorithmically compute radiocapitellar line displacement, and a separate binary classifier detects associated ulnar fractures, together flagging Monteggia fracture dislocations.
41395634.dataset_size: 320 AP/lateral elbow radiographs for segmentation; 157 paired radiographs for ulnar fracture classification
41395634.headline_result: radial head displacement detection sensitivity 92.3-100%, specificity 96.3-96.9%; ulnar fracture detection accuracy 87.5%, AUC 0.923
41395634.study_design: retrospective single-center diagnostic model development and validation

41397997.exclusion_reason: placental MRI texture analysis using linear regression models, not a trained AI/ML classifier; studies maternal exposure, not fetal/child diagnosis

41402819.model_family: causal forest algorithm with AI-quantified CT features
41402819.clinical_problem: identifying which children with Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia are most likely to benefit from flexible bronchoscopy
41402819.patient_population: pediatric MPP patients, derivation cohort n=753, validation cohort n=139, two centers
41402819.model_description: A causal forest model combines clinical, laboratory and AI-quantified CT features (consolidation/atelectasis volume, pneumonia attenuation, consolidation ratio) to estimate each patient's individual treatment effect from flexible bronchoscopy, identifying a subgroup that benefits from the procedure (reduced fever duration) versus one that does not.
41402819.release_evidence: an accessible online tool of this model facilitates practical clinical implementation
41402819.headline_result: fever duration reduced in FB-beneficial subgroup: beta=-1.16 (derivation, p<0.001), beta=-0.68 (validation, p=0.04)

41407887.model_family: meta-analysis comparing echocardiography, biomarkers, miRNA and AI models
41407887.clinical_problem: early detection of subclinical anthracycline-induced cardiotoxicity in childhood cancer survivors
41407887.patient_population: childhood cancer survivors treated with anthracyclines (73 studies in qualitative synthesis, 10 in meta-analysis)
41407887.model_description: Systematic review and meta-analysis pooling the prognostic accuracy of echocardiography (global longitudinal strain), serum biomarkers, microRNAs, and AI-based models for predicting chemotherapy-induced cardiotoxicity in pediatric cancer patients; AI-based models had the highest pooled predictive AUC among the modalities compared.
41407887.headline_result: pooled AUC ~0.80 for AI-based models vs ~0.72 for global longitudinal strain

41431395.clinical_problem: improving prenatal detection of congenital heart disease on obstetric ultrasound
41431395.patient_population: fetuses undergoing obstetric ultrasound screening for congenital heart disease
41431395.model_description: Review of AI applications in fetal cardiac ultrasound, including automated standard-view acquisition, congenital heart disease detection, and cardiac biometry, plus emerging generative AI, self-supervised learning, and NLP-based report automation.
41431395.headline_result: AI has shown expert-level performance in view classification, CHD detection, and cardiac biometry (as reported by cited literature)

41437729.clinical_problem: overcoming motion, low signal-to-noise ratio, and slice misregistration limitations of fetal MRI
41437729.model_description: Review of AI applications in fetal MRI: image reconstruction, denoising, motion correction, automated segmentation, and quantitative analysis including gestational-age estimation and anomaly detection, noting that most studies use small single-center datasets with limited external validation.

41477272.exclusion_reason: diagnostic accuracy study of expert radiologist chest radiograph interpretation for pediatric TB; no AI/ML model evaluated, AI mentioned only as a future direction

41494355.exclusion_reason: narrative review of synthetic data generation across pediatrics broadly (neonatology, oncology, radiology, neurodevelopment); not focused on radiology imaging AI specifically
